Host stores overlord_addon_body_damage_state and presentation draws the payload with DAMAGED/REALLYDAMAGED when no rider object exists.

title: [Pathfind] Dynamic occupancy is layer-blind — deck traffic blocks the roadbed under the span
description: C++ Pathfinder::updateGoal stamps LAYER cells; ground only at bridge ends. Live update_dynamic_obstacles writes XZ-only masks. Player-visible: units on a bridge jam the road underneath and vice versa.
close_reason: Live PathfindingGrid stamps updatePos/updateGoal on LAYER occupancy; ground only at objectInteractsWithBridgeEnd. Leftover update_goal already matched C++; wired update_goal_for_object + sync_pathfinder_pos to pass the flag.

title: Heat-haze pass still samples default texture, not backbuffer copy
description: hq-d8wvu now builds C++ 5-vertex view-space quads with center UV warp and draws them on the live present path instead of world decals. ParticleRenderer::render_heat_haze still binds default_bind_group (white) because the color target cannot be sampled while writing. Need a COPY_SRC scene copy (or previous-frame texture) bound as the heat-haze sampler so jet/napalm actually warp the framebuffer like W3DSmudgeManager.
close_reason: Live heat-haze now CopyRects the color target (W3DSmudgeManager::render) into a COPY_DST scene texture and binds that instead of default_bind_group. RenderFrame exposes color_texture(); enqueue_client_effect_draw passes it into render_heat_haze.

title: [DemoTrap] Standard splash is single-radius falloff, not 600/25 + 400/50
description:
## C++
Weapon.ini DemoTrapDetonationWeapon: Primary 600 r25, Secondary 400 r50, affects SELF/ALLIES/ENEMIES/NEUTRALS.

## Live
`host_mines.rs:255-258` `uses_dual_ring` is false for Standard. `demo_trap_damage_at` (host_mines.rs:309-321) uses `damage_at_distance(600, 25)` — full only to 12.5, 0 beyond 25. Chem/Demo dual-ring is implemented.

## Player-visible
Units 25–50wu from a standard trap take 400 in C++, 0 in Rust. Units 12–25wu take reduced vs full 600.
close_reason: Standard DemoTrapDetonationWeapon now uses dual-ring 600/25 + 400/50 instead of single-radius falloff.

title: [Mines] EMP pads deal 100 HE — no NeutronBlast unmanned
description:
## C++
ChinaEMPMine DetonationWeapon = NeutronMineWeapon (1 dmg + ProjectileObject NeutronBlastObject). NeutronBlastBehavior radius 20, no airborne, no allies. Infantry die / vehicles go unmanned; not a 100-dmg HE blast.

## Live
`host_mines.rs:513-524` `land_mine_for_template("…empmine")` only sets virtual=8 + regen. Damage stays HostMineKind::LandMine 100 / r5 (`host_mines.rs:145-166`). `stealth_mines.rs` `apply_mine_splash` is generic HE falloff. No neutron/EMP status.

## Player-visible
EMP upgrade looks and plays like standard HE mines. Vehicles take HP instead of becoming unmanned; infantry take 100 splash instead of neutron death. Not hq-4l9hi (EMP upgrade places more standard mines — placement count) and not hq-s12g (instant EMP place).
close_reason: ChinaEMPMine uses NeutronBlast radius 20: infantry die, vehicles unmanned, no 100 HE.

title: [Mines] China pad collide radius 8 vs retail geometry 30
description:
## C++
`MinefieldBehavior.cpp:321-424` `onCollide` uses partition geometry. Retail ChinaStandardMine / ChinaEMPMine / ChinaClusterMine GeometryMajorRadius = 30. Trip when footprints overlap a 30wu disk.

## Live
`host_mines.rs:70-71, 136-139` `LAND_MINE_GEOMETRY_RADIUS = 8.0` and `default_trigger_range = 8.0`. `stealth_mines.rs:2709-2710` `land_mine_geometry_contacts` uses that 8.

## Player-visible
Units walk through minefields that would have detonated in ZH. A tank 20wu from a pad is safe in Rust, dead in C++. Not hq-fnkrs (never tripped on geometry — contact test now exists, but radius is wrong).
close_reason: China pad collide/trigger radius is now GeometryMajorRadius 30.

title: [Capture] Human capture ignores shroud/fog
description:
## C++
`ActionManager.cpp:1036-1037`, `:76-98`: `canCaptureBuilding` rejects fogged/shrouded targets for human, non-script orders.

## Live
`can_unit_capture_building` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/object_queries.rs:1904-1988) has stealth/garrison/relation checks but **no shroud**. Hacker Disable Building on the same file does check shroud.

## Player-visible
Player can order capture on fogged/shrouded structures; C++ refuses the action.
close_reason: Human capture now rejects fogged/shrouded structures; script/in-progress channels still skip the shroud gate.

title: [Capture] Infantry/Lotus prep never stamps RAISING_FLAG or FIRING_A laser
description:
## C++
`SpecialAbilityUpdate.cpp:988-1022`, `:1025-1056`: Infantry prep sets MODELCONDITION_RAISING_FLAG and syncs anim to PreparationTime. Lotus/hacker-style capture creates the laser special object and sets FIRING_A.

## Live
`start_capture_preparation` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/support_states.rs:1636-1703) sets EVA + infiltration + `capture_channel` only. `leftover_sa_set_pack_model` is never called from the Capturing branch. RAISING_FLAG is used for surrender, not capture.

## Player-visible
Ranger/Red Guard/Rebel never raise the flag during capture. Lotus has no hack beam / laptop pose during the steal. Not hq-xu0pu (leftover DoCaptureFX) and not leftover SA UNPACKING beads (hq-yhpco / hq-k0d5e).
close_reason: Infantry capture prep stamps RAISING_FLAG; Lotus stamps FIRING_A and spawns the hack beam.

title: [Crush] Overlap crush aims with velocity, not facing
description:
## C++
`PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1488-1526` uses `crusherMe->getUnitDirectionVector2D()` as the crush ray (perp-to-facing, then past-point).

## Live
`physics_motion.rs:299-323` uses **velocity** if non-zero, else a position delta, then `select_crush_target_by_perp_residual`.

## Player-visible
A turning / sliding tank crushes the wrong end, or never crosses the past-point gate so the car sits under the hull uncrushed. Not hq-be4ku (crush points use selection_radius) and not hq-y3ueg (cars take infantry instant-squish).
close_reason: Overlap crush uses unit facing (getUnitDirectionVector2D), not velocity.

title: [Mines] DISARM cannot defuse demo traps — only detonation
description:
## C++
`Weapon.cpp:601-608` DISARM estimate is nonzero for KINDOF_MINE | BOOBY_TRAP | DEMOTRAP. `Weapon.cpp:2509-2534` if no LandMineInterface, those KindOfs → `destroyObject` (safe douse, no explosion) + academy recordMineCleared.

## Live
`host_mines.rs:1116-1127` `can_clear_mine_kind(DemoTrap) = false`. `stealth_mines.rs:2550-2551` skip DemoTrap on clear acquire. Combat DISARM targeting uses the same gate. Killing the trap goes through DetonateWhenKilled (`stealth_mines.rs:2418-2430`).

## Player-visible
Clear Mines / dozer DISARM will not defuse a demo trap. Attacking it detonates (600/400 splash). Retail dozer scoops it with no explosion. Opposite of closed hq-x7vb3 (silently deleted traps); current live path refuses disarm and explodes instead.
close_reason: can_clear_mine_kind(DemoTrap) is true; DISARM destroyObject path defuses without splash.

title: [CarBomb] Convert plays FXList name as audio — no FX_MakeCarBombSuccess
description:
## C++
`ConvertToCarBombCrateCollide.cpp:106-108`: `FXList::doFXObj(m_fxList, other)` → FX_MakeCarBombSuccess (sound TerroristCarBomb).

## Live
`support_states.rs:4980-4986` queues `CAR_BOMB_CONVERT_AUDIO` = `"MakeCarBombSuccess"` (host_car_bomb.rs:41-47). That is the FXList name, not a sound. `CAR_BOMB_CONVERT_FX_LIST` / `CAR_BOMB_CONVERT_FX_SOUND` are honesty constants only — never dispatched.

## Player-visible
No convert flash/particles; convert sound missing or a failed lookup. Car just changes team. Not hq-oprp3 (TerroristInCar extra voices on the converted car).
close_reason: Convert dispatches FX_MakeCarBombSuccess / TerroristCarBomb, not the FXList name as audio.

title: [Capture] Command_CaptureBuilding always enabled — no upgrade/cooldown/in-use gray
description:
## C++
`ControlBarCommand.cpp:1385-1415`: Capture is GUI_COMMAND_SPECIAL_POWER. Not ready (StartsPaused / Infantry Capture Building upgrade / Lotus reload) → COMMAND_NOT_READY + inverse clock. `isPowerCurrentlyInUse` → COMMAND_RESTRICTED.

## Live
`presentation_frame/apply.rs:1393-1427` pushes Ranger/Red Guard/Rebel/Lotus `Command_CaptureBuilding` with `true` always. `capture_power_ready` is computed elsewhere but never used here. No in-use gray, no recharge clock.

## Player-visible
Capture looks available before the Infantry Capture Building upgrade, during Lotus cooldown, and while already capturing. Click arms targeting, then execution fails. Not hq-8zho8 (HackInternet/CombatDrop) and not leftover SA packing beads.
close_reason: Command_CaptureBuilding is now disabled when the power is not ready or already in use.

title: [DemoTrap] Detonation is instant — no 1s warning FX/weapon
description:
## C++
`DemoTrapUpdate::detonate` (DemoTrapUpdate.cpp:240-250) fires `m_detonationWeaponTemplate` (NULL — INI line commented) then `kill()`. Retail GLADemoTrap SlowDeath: DestructionDelay=1000, FX=INITIAL FX_GLADemoTrapWarning, Weapon=FINAL DemoTrapDetonationWeapon. Player hears/sees the warning and has 1s to run before splash.

## Live
`detonate_mine_internal` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/stealth_mines.rs:2963+) applies splash and `mark_object_for_destruction` on the same frame. `DEMO_TRAP_DESTRUCTION_DELAY_FRAMES = 30` exists in host_mines.rs:977-980 but is never used on the tick path.

## Player-visible
Proximity / manual / killed traps nuke instantly. No warning beep/FX, no 1s flee window. Not hq-0bms4 (DetonateWhenKilled never fired — that path now exists, but still instant).
close_reason: Demo trap detonate arms a 30-frame SlowDeath warning before splash.

title: [Hijack] Mixed selection lets Rebel/non-hijacker steal the vehicle
description:
## C++
`ActionManager::canHijackVehicle` / `canConvertObjectToCarBomb` require **that unit’s** `isHijackedVehicleCrateCollide` / `isCarBombCrateCollide`. Mixed RMB `MSG_ENTER` (CommandXlat.cpp:1856-1889): only the terrorist/hijacker collide converts; a Rebel in the same selection does not steal the car.

## Live
`execute_hijack` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/command_executor/abilities.rs:78-103) queues `PendingSpecialAbility::Hijack` for every selected mover that is alive and not same-team. `execute_convert_carbomb` (abilities.rs:203-227) same — any selected mover. Completion (`support_states.rs:4409-4499`, `4913-4994`) never checks hijacker/terrorist (Sabotage *does* check saboteur at 4509-4513).

## Player-visible
Select Hijacker+Rebel, RMB enemy tank → Rebel can steal it and ride-hide if the tank has EjectPilotDie. Select Terrorist+Rebel, RMB a civilian car → Rebel converts it and is consumed. Not hq-ofk4z (RMB used to attack instead).
close_reason: execute_hijack and execute_convert_carbomb now require hijacker/terrorist; completion path rejects the rest.

title: [Crush] First crush of a car always becomes TOTAL wreck
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior` overlap crush (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/PhysicsUpdate.cpp) applies HUGE crush damage only. It does not write body crush flags. `CrushDie::onDie` (CrushDie.cpp:151-180) then runs `crushLocationCheck` against the previous flags (usually both false) and writes FRONT / BACK / TOTAL + model bits.

## Live
`Object::check_for_overlap_collision` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/object/physics_motion.rs:340-358) writes `front_crushed` / `back_crushed` **before** `take_damage`. Destroy then `fire_crush_die_from_crusher` (death.rs:513-543) calls `crush_location_check` with those flags already set. CrushDie.cpp:81-109: if the other end is the remaining candidate and the first flag is already true, the result is TOTAL. Flags and FRONTCRUSHED/BACKCRUSHED are overwritten.

## Player-visible
Civilian cars / crushable vehicles never show the half-crushed wreck. First tank pass always flattens both ends. Not hq-u41xk (CrushDie never recomputed — that path now runs, but after physics already stamped a flag).
close_reason: Physics no longer stamps crush flags; CrushDie writes FRONT/BACK on first pass.

description: C++ Object::xfer persists m_commandSetStringOverride. Leftover object_xfer.rs:1070 xfers it. Live snapshot has no field. Player-visible: load after ChinaMines/SatelliteHack/Overlord addon/Demo SuicideBomb → base command set returns.

C++ doNamedHunt/doTeamHunt/doNamedGuard/doTeamGuard/doPlayerHunt.

Live try_physics_collide applies apply_structure_stiffness_bounce to every allow_collide_force mover. Player-visible: units stutter/lurch along walls.

title: [Loco] Stunned/airborne units keep marching — no getIsStunned or AllowAirborneMotiveForce gate
description: C++ Locomotor.cpp:836-841 returns immediately when physics->getIsStunned(); :1064-1066 skips motive unless AllowAirborneMotiveForce. Leftover move_dispatch.rs ports both. Live world_tick/movement.rs gates only is_disabled(); shock_stun_frames units keep blending march velocity. Player-visible: tossed units run mid-air instead of ragdolling.

Leftover move_dispatch.rs already ports both. HostLocomotorBinding now carries allow_motive_force_while_airborne from INI onto Object and GameWorld entities.

Live Main parses ShadowSizeX/Y but never Shadow bitstring; leftover apply_terrain_decal hardcodes texture 'shadow' and geometry-radius size. Live dispatcher helper (executor/dispatch.rs:1590) is button-existence-only; leftover eval_skirmish.rs:381 reads empty OBJECT_REGISTRY so ALL vacuously true / PARTIAL always false. title: [Weapon] Splash RadiusDamageAffects uses faction-Team equality, not Player relationship

Live radius_damage_affects_victim (weapon_bootstrap/collide.rs:103-140) uses shooter_team==victim_team. Impact snapshot combat.rs:672-677 freezes no owner. Microwave/ECM same_team skip. title: [Save] Live host silently deletes saves beyond 10 slots; C++ never deletes and numbers to 99999999

Live SaveFileManager::enforce_save_limit deletes oldest past MAX_SAVE_SLOTS=10 after every save (save_file.rs). Popup next_popup_save_slot was save_01..save_10. Player-visible data loss including leftover mission saves in the same UserData/Save dir. Host-invented cleanup_old_auto_saves keeps 5. Fix: drop deletion; allocate lowest unused 8-digit slot. Partial fix already landed this session.

title: [Harvest] Worker mine-clear never dumps carried boxes
description:
## C++
`WorkerAIUpdate::aiDoCommand` after every command (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/AIUpdate/WorkerAIUpdate.cpp:1005-1014`): if `isClearingMines() && m_numberBoxes > 0`, set boxes to 0 and `updateDrawableSupplyStatus`. Harvesting workers have `WEAPONSET_MINE_CLEARING_DETAIL` armed (`:286-287`), so a mine-clear divert while carrying drops the crate and clears CARRYING.

## Live
`arm_worker_harvest_mine_clearing` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/support_states.rs:6330`) only sets the mine-clear weaponset while Gathering/Returning. No path zeros `stored_resources.supplies` or updates collector drawable boxes when the worker actually clears a mine (`host_mines.rs` / bored mine-clear in `rebuild_dozer.rs:1232`).

## Player-visible
A GLA worker that walks over / is tasked onto a mine while carrying a crate keeps the box and still deposits it. C++ workers drop the crate (lose the $75) the moment they start mine-clear.
close_reason: Mine-clear weaponset enable dumps stored supplies like C++ WorkerAIUpdate::aiDoCommand

title: [Harvest] Allied supply centers accept drop-off C++ forbids
description:
## C++
`ActionManager::canTransferSuppliesAt` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/Common/RTS/ActionManager.cpp:224-230`): a Supply Center is legal only if `transferDest->getControllingPlayer() == obj->getControllingPlayer()`. Comment: "not merely an ally... otherwise you may find yourself funding your allies." Auto-search (`ResourceGatheringManager`) uses the same legality.

## Live
`supply_center_accepts_deposit` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/support_states.rs:6967-6994`) returns true for same owner **or** `Relationship::Allies` (`:6990-6991`), and falls back to same `Team` (`:6993`).
`ReturningResources` then credits the **center owner** (`:5752-5767`).

## Player-visible
A loaded truck/worker/Chinook will auto-path to an allied Supply Center / Stash and dump cash into the ally's wallet. C++ never offers that dock; you cannot accidentally fund an ally.
close_reason: supply_center_accepts_deposit requires the same controlling player; allied drop-off refused (C++ canTransferSuppliesAt)

title: Splash SELF skip misses the producer — factory takes allied splash C++ ignores
description:
## C++
`WeaponTemplate::dealDamageInternal` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Weapon.cpp:1328-1337): if `WEAPON_AFFECTS_SELF` is unset, skip both the source object and `source->getProducerID()`. Comment: missiles must not injure their launcher, and produced units must not splash the building that made them.

Default `RadiusDamageAffects` is ALLIES|ENEMIES|NEUTRALS without SELF (Weapon.cpp:271). A Crusader shell that catches its War Factory in the secondary ring is skipped because the tank's producer is the factory.

## Live
`radius_damage_affects_victim` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/weapon_bootstrap/collide.rs:118-119) only special-cases `shooter_id == victim_id`. There is no producer-id check. `CombatSystem` Area splash (combat.rs:1841-1857) uses that helper for every non-primary victim.

`PendingProjectile.shooter_id` is the launching unit (object/attack.rs:333-361), so the factory is a same-team ally and is allowed by ALLIES.

## Player-visible
Tank/artillery/missile splash next to your own War Factory, airfield, or Stinger Site damages (or kills) the producing building. C++ leaves that building untouched unless the weapon explicitly lists SELF.
close_reason: Fixed in live GeneralsRust/Code/Main with TDD tests

title: Splash shockwave tapers from the firer, not the blast, and stuns outside the damage ring
description:
## C++
`WeaponTemplate::dealDamageInternal` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Weapon.cpp:1279-1284) iterates only `max(primaryRadius, secondaryRadius)`. Shockwave is attached to those victims only.

Shock vector is `victimPos - sourcePos` (the FIRER), not impact (Weapon.cpp:1385-1430). `Object::attemptDamage` (Object.cpp:1811-1822) tapers with `|victim-source| / ShockWaveRadius` (clamped to 1). A Tomahawk/nuke detonating hundreds of units from the launcher saturates to `ShockWaveTaperOff` strength (retail seed 0.75 → 75% of amount) even at ground zero.

## Live
`CombatSystem` Area handler (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/combat.rs:1821-1899) sets `push_outer = max(damageRadius, shockRadius)` so units outside the blast but inside ShockWaveRadius still get `apply_shock_wave_impulse`.

`compute_shock_wave_force` (weapon_bootstrap/shock_damage.rs:11-39) tapers from IMPACT on the XZ plane. Near ground zero the multiplier is 1.0 (full ShockWaveAmount), ~1.33× C++'s saturated 0.75 for a ranged blast.

Tank-gun/Tomahawk/nuke/terrorist seeds all author ShockWaveAmount/Radius (shock_damage.rs:98-156).

## Player-visible
Artillery, Tomahawks, nukes, and tank shells fling and stun units harder at the crater than C++, and stun units standing outside the damage ring that C++ never even considers. Direction of the shove is away from the explosion, not away from the firing unit.
close_reason: Fixed in live GeneralsRust/Code/Main with TDD tests

title: [Occupy] Unmanned recrew skips setCaptured and script name transfer
description:
## C++
`PhysicsBehavior::onCollide` unmanned handoff (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1186-1205): any infantry whose ignored-obstacle is that husk `clearDisabled(DISABLED_UNMANNED)`, `setCaptured(true)`, `defect` to the infantry team, `TheScriptEngine->transferObjectName(infantry, vehicle)`, then `destroyObject(infantry)`. Campaign scripts that named the infantry now control the recrewed tank; `OBJECT_STATUS_CAPTURED` / script-captured tests become true.

## Live
Enter-path occupy (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/support_states.rs:3218-3265) only clears `disabled_unmanned`, `set_team_and_owner`, and destroys the infantry. No `setCaptured`, no `transfer_script_object_name`.
Collide-path `try_infantry_unmanned_reclaim` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/rebuild_dozer.rs:12-43) is USA-Pilot-only (`veterancy_crate_collide.supports_pilot_recrew`) and also skips captured-bit + name transfer.

## Player-visible
After a Jarmen Kell snipe, walking a named Ranger/Red Guard into the husk recrews the vehicle but scripts still address the dead infantry name; captured-object script conditions stay false. Retail retargets the name onto the tank and marks it captured. Not hq-7rr63 (RMB Enter missing) and not hq-8womv (veterancy kept).
close_reason: Unmanned recrew now setCaptured and transfers the infantry script name on enter and collide.

title: [DemoTrap] Proximity uses Aircraft KindOf, not isAboveTerrain
description:
## C++
`DemoTrapUpdate::update` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/DemoTrapUpdate.cpp:207-211) skips a candidate when `other->isAboveTerrain()` — any object whose height-above-terrain is > 0 (paratroopers, jumping infantry, hovering helicopters). Grounded aircraft still trip the fuse. Ignore is height, not KindOf.

## Live
`GameLogic::update_mines_and_demo_traps` victim collect (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/stealth_mines.rs:2526-2528) drops anyone with `KindOf::Aircraft || status.airborne_target`. Parachuting/jumping infantry stay in the victim list and trip `FROM_CENTER_2D` range (stealth_mines.rs:2708-2714). A landed Chinook/Comanche is KindOf Aircraft so it never trips, even sitting on the pad.

## Player-visible
Paratroopers and jump-jets set off GLA demo traps in mid-air (retail ignores them). A landed Chinook on a trap is safe (retail detonates). Not hq-3qyy2 (neutrals), hq-dpe6f (dozer immunity), or hq-t53k3 (manual mode).
close_reason: Victim collect uses is_above_terrain (host Y-up) instead of Aircraft KindOf / airborne_target.

title: [Hack] HackInternet never unpacks/packs — idle pose and instant walk-away
description:
## C++
`HackInternetAIUpdate::hackInternet` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/AIUpdate/HackInternetAIUpdate.cpp:146) enters UNPACKING.
`UnpackingState::onEnter` (HackInternetAIUpdate.cpp:270-281) clears PACKING/FIRING_A, sets MODELCONDITION_UNPACKING, plays per-unit `UnitUnpack`, and holds `UnpackTime`.
`HackInternetState::onEnter` (cpp:436-438) sets MODELCONDITION_FIRING_A (laptop-out cash pose).
`aiDoCommand` while HACK_INTERNET/PACKING (cpp:113-125) stores the new order and switches to PACKING; `PackingState::onEnter` (cpp:359-369) sets MODELCONDITION_PACKING and plays `UnitPack`. The pending move only runs after pack completes (cpp:86-95).

## Live
`GameLogic::start_hacker_internet_hack` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/resources_income.rs:787-816) only starts the cash schedule and forces Idle — no UNPACKING/FIRING_A stamp, no UnitUnpack.
`stop_hacker_internet_hack` (resources_income.rs:820-822) is `hacker_income.stop_hacking` (immediate registry drop).
`note_hacker_ai_command` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/unit_commands.rs:94-97) is called from `unit_command_move_to` (unit_commands.rs:114) and instantly stops cash then paths. No PACKING delay, no UnitPack, no pending-command hold.

## Player-visible
China Hacker never plays the laptop unpack/pack anims or UnitUnpack/UnitPack. While "hacking" they stand in the idle pose. A move/attack click walks them away immediately instead of packing first. Distinct from hq-088bj (first-cash timing) and hq-ptc85 (income continuing while moving) and leftover Lotus/Burton SA packing beads.
close_reason: HackInternet now unpacks to FIRING_A and packs with a pending command before walking away.

title: [Hijack] Ride-hide treats any world-Y>5 vehicle as airborne
description:
## C++
`HijackerUpdate::update` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/HijackerUpdate.cpp:67) stamps `m_wasTargetAirborne = target->isSignificantlyAboveTerrain()`.
`Thing::isSignificantlyAboveTerrain` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/Common/Thing/Thing.cpp:308-312) is height-above-terrain `> -(3*3)*m_gravity` (~4.5 world units off the ground). A tank on a hill or ramp has ~0 height-above-terrain and is not airborne. Only a flying/falling ride (Comanche, mid-air wreck) puts the hijacker in `AmericaParachute` on vehicle death (HijackerUpdate.cpp:104-121).

## Live
`GameLogic::tick_hijacker_updates` (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_tick/crates.rs:702-706) uses `v.status.airborne_target || v.get_position().y > 5.0`. Host Y is world height, not height-above-terrain. Almost every ground vehicle on Alpine/uneven maps sits at Y>5, so `hijacker_was_airborne` is latched every tick. When that vehicle dies, crates.rs:697-698 always calls `put_hijacker_in_airborne_parachute`.

## Player-visible
Hijacking a Crusader/Overlord on a slope and then losing the vehicle ejects the hijacker in an AmericaParachute from ~50 height instead of standing on the wreck. Retail walks the hijacker out on the ground.

Not hq-t2ckr (ride-hide drawable/partition) and not hq-0e9p7 (vision/shroud endow).
close_reason: Ride-hide airborne now uses height-above-terrain (terrain sample, host Y-up), not world-Y>5.

title: Garrison InitialRoster never spawns occupants on create
description:
## C++
`GarrisonContain::onObjectCreated` (`GarrisonContain.cpp:1737-1762`) reads `m_initialRoster` (`GarrisonContain.h:50,59-67` INI `InitialRoster = TemplateName [count]`) and `ThingFactory::newObject` + `addToContain` for each slot when the building is created.

## Live
No `InitialRoster` / `initial_roster` symbol in `GeneralsRust/Code/Main`. `spawn_templates.rs` ingests Garrison `ContainMax` / `IsEnclosingContainer` / `ImmuneToClearBuildingAttacks` / `TimeForFullHeal` but never the roster name or count. `apply_garrison_contain_on_enter` only runs after a player/AI Enter.

(Transport `InitialPayload` for Troop Crawler / Listening Outpost / Combat Cycle *is* applied on create — this gap is GarrisonContain only.)

## Player-visible
A civilian/tech bunker authored `InitialRoster = GLAInfantryRebel 3` (or any map-placed pre-garrisoned structure) spawns empty. Retail already has infantry inside and can fire / show occupied. Live looks vacant until someone walks in.
close_reason: InitialRoster parsed and spawned on create via leftover parse_from_tokens + apply_garrison_initial_roster

title: Garrison HealObjects never heals occupants
description:
## C++
`GarrisonContain::update` calls `healObjects()` (`GarrisonContain.cpp:931`, impl `:1101-1161`) when `m_doIHealObjects` (INI `HealObjects`). Each occupant gets a sliver `maxHealth / framesForFullHeal` per frame (`DAMAGE_HEALING`), then snaps to full after `TimeForFullHeal` frames inside.

## Live
`spawn_templates.rs:1294-1299` parses `TimeForFullHeal` onto `contain_module.frames_for_full_heal`. `tick_heal_contain_and_tunnel` (`support_states.rs`) only consumes it for HealContain and TunnelTracker. `HealObjects` is never read. Garrison kind is not in that tick. Residual `garrison_heal_sliver_amount` is a formula-only honesty helper.

## Player-visible
Infantry inside a garrison authored `HealObjects = Yes` (TimeForFullHeal) never regenerate. Retail they visibly climb back to full HP while occupying the building.
close_reason: HealObjects parsed and garrison occupants sliver/snap heal via leftover garrison_heal_single_amount

title: [Particles] MULTIPLY shader subtracts to black instead of darkening
description:
## C++
`W3DParticleSys.cpp:300-302` (`streak`) and `:289-303` (`point/volume`) set `ShaderClass::_PresetMultiplicativeSpriteShader` for `ParticleSystemInfo::MULTIPLY`.
That preset is `SC_MUL_SPRITE` (WW3D2/shader.cpp:193-197): `SRCBLEND_ZERO`, `DSTBLEND_SRC_COLOR` → framebuffer = dest * src (darken smoke/shadows/scorch-style sprites).

## Live
`ParticleRenderer` multiply pipeline (GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameClient/src/effects/particle_renderer.rs:888-910) uses
`src_factor=Dst`, `dst_factor=Src`, `operation=Subtract`.
Result is `Dst*Src - Src*Dst = 0` (identically black).
The fragment shader (particle_multiply.wgsl:29-36) even documents "the blend state will multiply this with the framebuffer" and lerps toward white — the GPU blend then zeros that.

Main presents this pipeline via `enqueue_client_effect_draw` → `render_particles`.

## Player-visible
Authored Shader=MULTIPLY systems (dark smoke, shadow sprites, some explosion overlays) draw as solid black cards instead of darkening the scene behind them.
close_reason: MULTIPLY blend is dest*src (ZERO/SRC Add) not subtract-to-black

title: [Radar] Spacebar last-event uses host message queue not TheRadar
description:
## C++
`MSG_META_VIEW_LAST_RADAR_EVENT` (`CommandXlat.cpp:2843-2856`) calls `TheRadar->getLastEventLoc`. `internalCreateEvent` (`Radar.cpp:1105-1107`) records `m_lastRadarEvent` for every type *except* `RADAR_EVENT_BEACON_PULSE`. Spacebar always jumps to the last real event world pos (under-attack, construction, infiltration, …), never a beacon pulse.

## Live
`execute_view_last_radar_event` (`cheat_debug.rs:31-37`) uses `GameLogic::last_radar_event_position` (`eva_camera.rs:576-578`), which is the last `queue_radar_message_at` HUD entry (`production_eva.rs:598-621`). That queue:
- records script type-5 "Beacon pulse" (`:555-559`)
- records `queue_radar_ally` / `queue_radar_message` at `Vec3::ZERO` (`:514-515, 635-636`)
- 0.5s-dedups by kind so a later real event can be dropped
Leftover `RadarSystem::create_event` already skips BeaconPulse for `last_event` (`radar/mod.rs:1376-1377`) but spacebar never reads `get_last_event_loc`.

## Player-visible
Spacebar jumps to the last HUD radar *message* (beacon pulse, ally ping at origin, generic text) instead of the last TheRadar event. After a beacon, spacebar goes to the beacon; after an ally request, it can jump to the map origin.
close_reason: Spacebar uses TheRadar get_last_event_loc; beacon pulses skipped

title: [Radar] LeftHUD terrain/overlay/shroud skip C++ V-flip UV
description:
## C++
`W3DRadar` Image UV (`W3DRadar.cpp:880-903`) sets `lo.y=1, hi.y=0` so texture (0,0) (radar south) draws at the *bottom*. Comment: world +X right, +Y up. `drawImage` of terrain/overlay/shroud uses that flip. Events/view box use `radarToPixel` (`W3DRadar.cpp:220-222`) which also inverts Y. All layers agree: north is up.

## Live
`w3d_left_hud_draw` / `draw_radar_in_hud` (`hud.rs:254-292`) `draw_textured_rect`s leftover terrain, object overlay, and shroud textures with default UVs (no V flip). Overlay/shroud pixels are written at `y * WIDTH + x` matching radar-cell south at texture top (`mod.rs:1909`, `terrain.rs:158`). Event triangles, hero reticles, and the view box still go through leftover `radar_to_pixel` which *does* invert Y.

## Player-visible
Map, FOW, and unit blips are south-at-top. Attack triangles and the camera view box are north-at-top. They sit on opposite ends of the radar from the terrain they belong to.
close_reason: LeftHUD terrain/overlay/shroud draw with C++ V-flip UV

title: [Radar] Live LeftHUD clicks ignore letterbox and Y invert
description:
## C++
`LeftHUDInput` (`ControlBarCallback.cpp:231-233`) converts the click with `TheRadar->localPixelToRadar` then `radarToWorld`. `Radar::localPixelToRadar` (`Radar.cpp:692-754`) letterboxes via `findDrawPositions` (preserve map aspect) and inverts Y so world +Y (north) is up. Clicks on the black letterbox bars return false (no lookAt/move).

Leftover already ports this: `radar_screen_pixel_to_world` (`GameClient/.../radar_map.rs:55-91`) + `radar_draw_positions`.

## Live
When the host control-bar bridge is on, leftover LeftHUD only publishes raw screen coords (`control_bar_callbacks.rs:610-679`). Main remaps in `MinimapCoordinates::minimap_to_world` (`minimap_renderer.rs:438-448`): full window stretch, no letterbox, no Y invert. `handle_minimap_click` (`pipeline_minimap.rs:819-832`) never calls leftover `radar_screen_pixel_to_world`.

Closed hq-1ahz was leftover `localPixelToRadar` itself (now letterboxed). Live host does not use that function.

## Player-visible
Radar clicks land at the wrong world XY — worst on non-square maps (Alpine etc.). Clicking a blip issues lookAt/moveTo somewhere else; letterbox bars are treated as map.
close_reason: Live LeftHUD clicks letterbox and invert Y via localPixelToRadar math

title: [Radar] Live LeftHUD click rejects unexplored shroud
description:
## C++
`LeftHUDInput` (`ControlBarCallback.cpp:231-248, 289-292`) after a successful `radarToWorld` always `lookAt` / `MSG_DO_MOVETO` / special-power at that world point. No FOW / shroud test. Black radar cells are still valid camera and order targets.

## Live
`RenderPipeline::handle_minimap_click` (`pipeline_minimap.rs:819-832`) returns None unless `MinimapTextureRenderer::is_position_visible` (`minimap_renderer.rs:776-800`) is `Explored` or `Visible`. Unexplored `Hidden` cells drop the click.

## Player-visible
Clicking black (unexplored) radar does nothing: cannot jump the camera there or issue a move/special-power into the unknown, unlike retail.
close_reason: LeftHUD clicks no longer reject unexplored shroud

title: Gattling/minigunner retarget inside ContinuousFireCoast resets spin-up
description:
## C++
`FiringTracker::shotFired` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/FiringTracker.cpp:83-99): if the victim changes but `now < m_frameToStartCooldown` (ContinuousFireCoast still live), consecutive shots keep incrementing and the ramp does not spin down. Only a retarget after the coast window restarts the count at 1.

## Live
Specialized helpers `gattling_on_shot_fired` / `gattling_building_on_shot_fired` / `minigunner_on_shot_fired` implement that coast-carry (host_gattling_tank.rs:277-287, host_base_defense.rs:2247-2257). `update_combat` even calls `advance_gattling_continuous_fire` / `advance_minigunner_continuous_fire` (world_tick/combat.rs:2773-2796).

Then the same successful shot always calls `record_shot_at_target` (world_tick/combat.rs:3018). That helper (object/weapons.rs:999-1012) resets `consecutive_shots_at_target` to 1 on any target change with no coast check, and `update_continuous_fire_after_shot` (weapons.rs:1017-1046) overwrites `continuous_fire_level` / `continuous_fire_consecutive` from that reset count.

`Object::fire_at_ex` (object/attack.rs:419) also ends in `record_shot_at_target`, so the AttackStateMachine path has the same clobber.

## Player-visible
A spinning-up Gattling Tank, Gattling Cannon, or MiniGunner that switches targets inside its ~1s ContinuousFireCoast drops back to base rate of fire. C++ keeps MEAN/FAST through the switch. Rapid-fire VoiceRapidFire / barrel-spin stays delayed until the count rebuilds.
close_reason: Fixed in live GeneralsRust/Code/Main with TDD tests

title: [ScriptAct] PLAYER_HUNT and garrison/exit leftover-only on live host
description:
## C++
ScriptActions::doPlayerHunt sets Player::setUnitsShouldHunt on live units. doTeamGarrisonNearestBuilding / doNamedGarrisonSpecificBuilding / doPlayerGarrisonAllBuildings / doPlayerExitAllBuildings issue aiEnter / aiExit on live infantry and structures (ScriptActions.cpp garrison/hunt family).

## Live
do_player_hunt (actions_player_display_camera.rs:148-168) writes leftover leftover Player::set_units_should_hunt only. do_player_garrison_all_buildings / do_player_exit_all_buildings (actions_player.rs:352-428) iterate leftover leftover player.get_all_objects + leftover leftover TheGameLogic::find_object_by_id. do_named_garrison_* / do_team_garrison_* (actions_named.rs / actions_garrison.rs / actions_team_relations.rs) same leftover leftover lookup. No HostScriptMoveAttackRequest / host drain for hunt or garrison. Move/attack already have a host drain; these do not.

## Player-visible
Campaign \"all units hunt\" leaves the army idle. Scripted garrison-nearest / garrison-this-building / evacuate-all never move live infantry into or out of buildings. Closed hq-zvfx wired leftover leftover Player iterators; leftover leftover executor still cannot see live host objects.

title: Bridge fire aims at span center, not the nearer C++ end point
description:
## C++
`WeaponTemplate::fireWeaponTemplate` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Weapon.cpp:819-831): if the victim is `KINDOF_BRIDGE`, `TheTerrainLogic->getBridgeAttackPoints` supplies two end points. The shot's `victimPos` (range check + projectile/hitscan destination) is the nearer end, not the span center.

## Live
Turret *aim* has a residual `nearer_bridge_attack_point` (world_tick/attack.rs:123-137, used at 1354-1361) that invents ±selection_radius on X only.

Fire ignores it:
- `Object::fire_at_ex` (object/attack.rs:359-369) queues `target_id` only.
- `drain_pending_projectiles` (combat.rs:959-963) aims at `obj.get_position()` (span center).
- `update_combat` (world_tick/combat.rs:231-234, 2140-2146) uses sneak-adjusted object position, then `take_damage` / splash at that center.

No live call to `getBridgeAttackPoints` / TerrainLogic bridge ends on the discharge path.

## Player-visible
Tank, artillery, bomber, and jet attacks on a map bridge explode on the middle of the span. C++ impacts the nearer tower/end. One-end-then-the-other bridge kills and end-local explosions do not happen.
close_reason: Fixed in live GeneralsRust/Code/Main with TDD tests

title: Aurora afterburner sneak offset is ignored at fire — shots still hit
description:
## C++
`WeaponTemplate::fireWeaponTemplate` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Weapon.cpp:802-816): if the victim AI reports `getSneakyTargetingOffset`, the shot is retargeted to the offset *position* and `victimObj`/`victimID` are cleared. The projectile/hitscan therefore flies at a point behind the jet (Aurora `SneakyOffsetWhenAttacking` = -20) and misses.

`WeaponTemplate::shouldProjectileCollideWith` (Weapon.cpp:702-708): a unit that currently has a sneaky offset is immune to projectile collision.

## Live
`Object::get_sneaky_targeting_offset` exists (GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/object/jets.rs:496-514) and is applied only for *aim* (`world_tick/combat.rs:234`, `world_tick/attack.rs:1369`).

Fire itself keeps the object lock:
- `Object::fire_at_ex_defer_weapon_barrel_advance` (object/attack.rs:359-369) always queues `target_id: Some(target_id)`.
- `drain_pending_projectiles` (combat.rs:959-963) resolves aim from the live object position, not the sneak offset.
- `update_combat` default hit (world_tick/combat.rs:2140-2146) calls `take_damage_from_typed_death` on `target_id`.

No sneak-offset collide skip exists in `CombatSystem` structure/target hit tests (combat.rs:1453-1690).

## Player-visible
Aurora (and any jet with `SneakyOffsetWhenAttacking`) afterburner does not make incoming shots miss. C++ Patriots/tanks/AA fire behind the jet; live shots still connect.
close_reason: Fixed in live GeneralsRust/Code/Main with TDD tests

title: estimateWeaponDamage never gates fire — Pathfinder shoots empty/UC buildings
description:
## C++
`WeaponTemplate::estimateWeaponTemplateDamage` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Weapon.cpp:546-638):
- KINDOF_STRUCTURE + DAMAGE_SNIPER + empty contain → 0 (\"noone home to take the bullet\", firebase/stinger).
- DAMAGE_SURRENDER or AllowAttackGarrisonedBldgs → 1 only if occupied garrisonable and not immune; else fall through.
- DAMAGE_DISARM → 1 only vs mine/booby/demo; else 0.
- Shrubbery only if DeathType BURNED.

`ActiveBody::estimateDamage` (ActiveBody.cpp:264-292): DAMAGE_KILL_GARRISONED is 1 only if occupied garrisonable; DAMAGE_SNIPER vs UNDER_CONSTRUCTION structure is 0.

`ActionManager::canFireWeaponAtObject` (ActionManager.cpp:1960-1962) and `WeaponSet` targeting (WeaponSet.cpp:701-702, 845) refuse the shot when estimate is 0.

## Live
`GameLogic::get_able_to_use_weapon_against_target` (world_tick/mood.rs:704-819) checks AntiMask, stealth, and range only — no estimate. Comment at mood.rs:807: \"Contact / invalid pitch residual not expanded — range gate only.\"

`Object::can_target_with_slot` (object/stealth.rs:495-561) has a DISARM-vs-mine residual but no SNIPER-vs-empty-structure, SNIPER-vs-UNDER_CONSTRUCTION, KILL_GARRISONED occupancy, or AllowAttackGarrisoned occupancy check. `select_combat_weapon_slot` / auto-acquire / attack cursor use these helpers.

There is no live `estimate_weapon_damage` under GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src.

## Player-visible
Pathfinder / Jarmen Kell get an attack cursor and will fire at empty firebases, empty civ buildings, and buildings still going up. C++ shows no attack and will not auto-acquire those. Microwave/flashbang/flame can also be ordered at empty buildings C++ refuses (estimate 0).
close_reason: Fixed in live GeneralsRust/Code/Main with TDD tests

title: Live findPath skips hierarchical zone-block prune — long orders hit 10k cap
description:
## C++
`Pathfinder::findPath` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/AI/AIPathfind.cpp:6364-6383`):
1. `clientSafeQuickDoesPathExist` zone gate
2. `clearPassableFlags` + `findHierarchicalPath` (10×10 `ZONE_BLOCK_SIZE` coarse search, `AIPathfind.h:479`)
3. On hierarchical success, fine A* is pruned to marked-passable blocks (`examineCellsCallback` `:6005` `m_zoneManager.isPassable`)
4. On hierarchical fail, `setAllPassable` then `internalFindPath`

Hierarchical also jumps via `interactsWithBridge` / layer start–end cells (`:7595-7623`) so long river crossings stay inside a small corridor.

## Live
Host `PathfindingSystem::find_path_via_crate` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/pathfinding.rs:2946-3155`) calls leftover `AStarPathfinder::find_path_with_start_layer` with `MAX_PATH_ITERATIONS` (10000, leftover `pathfind_complete/types.rs:22`). No `clearPassableFlags`, no `findHierarchicalPath`, no zone-block passable mask.

Leftover crate `PathfindingSystem::find_path` (`GameEngine/GameLogic/src/ai/pathfind_complete/find_path.rs:29-60`) still has the C++ probe, but the live host never uses that entry.

On fail, host falls back to `allow_partial` findClosest (`pathfinding.rs:3152-3154`).

## Player-visible
On large maps, a move/attack-move across the map can exhaust 10k expansions and return a partial closest path. Units walk partway and stop short of the click. C++ coarse-then-fine search still reaches the far bank (especially via a bridge corridor).
close_reason: Live find_path_via_crate now runs C++ hierarchical zone-block prune: clearPassableFlags, 10x10 block A* plus bridge start/end jumps, mark corridor + start box, else setAllPassable. Fine A* already consults is_zone_passable (examineCellsCallback). Leftover find_path wired to the same A* prune.

title: Path/terrain zones ignore bridge connectLayer — rally and dozer reject river crossings
description:
## C++
`PathfindZoneManager::calculateZones` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/AI/AIPathfind.cpp:2629-2633`) merges `m_hierarchicalZones` when a CLEAR ground cell has `getConnectLayer() > LAYER_GROUND` with that bridge layer's zone (`resolveZones`). `getEffectiveZone` (`:3169`) returns the hierarchical zone for ground locos.

`clientSafeQuickDoesPathExist` (`:7997-8044`) and `clientSafeQuickDoesPathExistForUI` (`:8055-8101`) compare those effective zones (ForUI also folds `getEffectiveTerrainZone` so buildings are ignored, but bridge merge still applies). `Pathfinder::findPath` (`:6367`) returns NULL if the structure-aware check fails.

Callers:
- Rally: `GameLogicDispatch.cpp:133` → `GUI:RallyPointNoPath`
- Move cursor: `CommandXlat.cpp:2240` `isQuickPathAvailable`
- Dozer place: `BuildAssistant.cpp:987` → `LBC_NO_CLEAR_PATH`

## Live
`rebuild_path_zones` / `rebuild_terrain_zones` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/pathfinding.rs:754-869`) 4-flood only ground cells. Water / Obstacle / BridgeImpassable / Cliff / Impassable are barriers. They never walk `ground_connect` or `bridge_layers`.

`stamp_bridge_deck` (`:923-1008`) does classify the deck and set entry `ground_connect`, and map load rebuilds zones after stamping (`world_save.rs:680-691`) — but the flood still cannot cross the river via the layer.

`quick_path_exists` (`pathfinding.rs:878-898`) / `quick_path_exists_for_ui` (`:803-816`) compare those flat zone ids. Water dest is hard-rejected (`:885-887`).

Rally (`world_scripts/unit_commands.rs:1061-1069`) and dozer reach (`ui_production.rs:973`) use this check. Crate A* can still hop the deck (`classified_bridge_layer_hops_across_river` test `:4781-4804`).

## Player-visible
Factory rally across a standing bridge shows GUI:RallyPointNoPath. Dozer cannot place a building on the far bank (no clear path). Move-cursor / isQuickPathAvailable consumers treat the far bank as unreachable. Units that skip the zone gate can still walk the deck.
close_reason: Live rebuild_path_zones/rebuild_terrain_zones now resolveZones-merge CLEAR ground cells with connectLayer > LAYER_GROUND (C++ AIPathfind.cpp:2629-2633). Leftover build_surface_combiners already matched; live floods store the remapped id so rally/dozer/ForUI accept far-bank crossings. Destroyed decks still drop ground_connect and split banks.

title: [Economy] Fake Black Market skips C++ ActualMoney=No cash popups
description:
## C++
`AutoDepositUpdate::update` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/AutoDepositUpdate.cpp:136-187`) always evaluates `moneyAmount = DepositAmount + boost`. `m_isActualMoney` only gates `Money::deposit` / `ScoreKeeper::addMoneyEarned` (`:145-149`). Floating `GUI:AddCash` still posts when `moneyAmount > 0` after the stealth/local/detected gate (`:151-187`). GLA fake Black Markets (`ActualMoney=No`) therefore show the same `$20` ticks as a real market without paying.

## Live
`update_black_market_deposits` drops any template whose name contains `"fake"` before scheduling (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/resources_income.rs:224-226`). `host_black_market.rs:8` documents this as residual-skip. No deposit **and** no floating text.

## Player-visible
A GLA fake Black Market is visually silent (no periodic `$20` floaters). In C++ the fake keeps the cash-tick tell so it can pass as a real market; live fakes are immediately distinguishable.
close_reason: Fake Black Markets still AutoDeposit floaters but skip credit_supplies/addMoneyEarned (C++ ActualMoney=No)

title: [Build] Construction ticks while dozer is still approaching the dock
description:
## C++
`DozerActionState` only advances percent after `DOZER_DO_BUILD_AT_DOCK` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/AIUpdate/DozerAIUpdate.cpp:494-518`): move to the ACTION dock, wait until `ai->isIdle()`, then `startBuildingSound` and add `100/framesToBuild` per frame plus `maxHealth/framesToBuild` HP (`:526`).
Distance is measured to the **dock goal**, `max(MIN_ACTION_TOLERANCE=70, boundingSphere+15)` (`:318-325`). A dozer still walking does not assemble the building.

## Live
`update_construction` counts any living constructor whose `target == structure` and `pos.distance(build_pos) <= DOZER_MIN_ACTION_TOLERANCE` (70 from the **building center**) (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_tick/production.rs:10`, `:83-95`, `:118-132`). There is no idle-at-dock / `DOZER_DO_BUILD_AT_DOCK` gate. Percent, HP, `ACTIVELY_BEING_CONSTRUCTED`, and UnderConstruction loop start as soon as the dozer is within 70 of the origin.

## Player-visible
Place a building and watch the dozer walk in: the scaffold/partial mesh and HP bar start filling while the dozer is still pathing (and can finish a short build before arrival). C++ stays AWAITING_CONSTRUCTION until the dozer stops at the dock.
close_reason: update_construction only counts arrived/idle dozers at the site like C++ isIdle ACTION dock

title: [Harvest] ReallyDamaged warehouse still promotes dockers
description:
## C++
`SupplyWarehouseCripplingBehavior::onBodyDamageStateChange` calls `startCrippledEffects` → `DockUpdate::setDockCrippled(TRUE)` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Behavior/SupplyWarehouseCripplingBehavior.cpp:65-70`, `:103-106`).
`DockUpdate::update` never assigns `m_activeDocker` while `m_dockCrippled` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/DockUpdate/DockUpdate.cpp:385-396`): approach reservations stay allowed, enter clearance is never granted.
`SupplyWarehouseDockUpdate::setDockCrippled` (`SupplyWarehouseDockUpdate.cpp:118-147`) immediately kills a ground docker already inside, or `aiIdle` + `setForceWantingState` if they were only approaching.

## Live
`tick_live_dock_approach` always calls `promote_active(..., crippled=false)` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/host_supply_gather.rs:63`, `:322-339`).
`try_claim_dock` never reads warehouse `BODY_REALLYDAMAGED` before promoting (`support_states.rs:6541-6623`).
Cripple handling runs only after the collector already claimed and finished the warehouse delay (`support_states.rs:5421-5482`), so a wrecked pile still lines trucks up and then kills/idles them on the transfer tick.

## Player-visible
Attack a supply pile/warehouse to ReallyDamaged while trucks are harvesting: C++ trucks wait at the approach line then time out / go wanting; live trucks keep entering the wreck and die (ground) or get yanked idle only after they start the box transfer. Harvest at damaged piles is lethal instead of refused.
close_reason: ReallyDamaged/Rubble warehouses pass crippled into tick_live_dock_approach_ex so promote_active never grants enter (C++ DockUpdate m_dockCrippled)

title: [Harvest] Supply-center drop-off requires 14u of pad center before dock queue
description:
## C++
`SupplyCenterDockUpdate::action` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/DockUpdate/SupplyCenterDockUpdate.cpp:64-140`) has no center-distance gate. `AIDock` reserves `DockWaiting` bones via `DockUpdate::reserveApproachPosition` / `isClearToEnter` (`DockUpdate.cpp:191-195`, `:391-403`) and only the active docker dumps boxes.

## Live
`AIState::ReturningResources` computes `at_refinery` as `position.distance(refinery_pos) <= HOST_REPAIR_INTERACT_RANGE` (14) **before** `try_claim_dock` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/support_states.rs:5627-5634`, `host_repair.rs:40`).
If farther than 14 from the **center**, the truck paths at the pad origin (`:5881-5887`) and never enters the approach-bone queue. If `try_claim_dock` later returns `PathTo(bone)` outside that 14u bubble, the next tick treats the truck as not at the refinery and paths back to the center.

## Player-visible
Supply trucks / workers / Chinooks returning to a Supply Center (or GLA Stash) jam on the building hull, orbit the pad, or oscillate between waiting bones and the origin instead of queuing on DockWaiting and dropping cash. Multiple collectors cannot form a C++ dock line.
close_reason: ReturningResources calls try_claim_dock without a 14u pad-center gate; AIDock PathTo handles approach

title: [Select] Shift-click cannot drop the last selected unit
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/MessageStream/SelectionXlat.cpp:707-730`: Shift+point-click on an already-selected locally owned unit posts `MSG_REMOVE_FROM_SELECTED_GROUP` and `deselectDrawable`. The last remaining unit can be removed; selection is allowed to become empty.

## Live
`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/cnc_game_engine/mouse.rs:848-853` after `select_left_click_target`: if `selected_objects` is empty, it `host_set_selection`s the clicked id (`force-select local object after predicate miss`). `select_left_click_target` (`:861-866`) Shift-toggles first and returns. Toggle of the sole selected unit empties the list, then the force-select immediately puts it back.

## Player-visible
Shift-clicking the only selected unit does nothing — it cannot be deselected. C++ lets the player empty the selection that way. Multi-unit Shift-deselect still works because the list is not empty after the toggle.
close_reason: Shift-deselect of the last unit is not force-reselected (C++ SelectionXlat empty group allowed)

title: [LookAt] Escape OPTIONS never stops RMB scroll or cancels drag
description:
## C++
`LookAtXlat.cpp:352-358` `MSG_META_OPTIONS` calls `stopScrolling()` (clears `m_isScrolling`, unlocks the mouse, restores `prevCursor`). RMB scroll does not resume until a new `MSG_RAW_MOUSE_RIGHT_BUTTON_DOWN`. `SelectionXlat.cpp:1253-1258` the same OPTIONS message sets `m_leftMouseButtonIsDown = FALSE` so a half-started box cannot become a drag after the menu.

## Live
`hotkeys.rs:1181-1207` Escape / OPTIONS only `host_toggle_retail_quit_menu()` (or pause fallback). It never calls `stop_rmb_lookat_scroll` (`mouse.rs:3485`) and never clears `is_dragging` / `selection_start`. `update_camera` still applies `LookAtScrollType::Rmb` while RMB is held, including under the quit menu (`Paused` is a live camera state). Releasing LMB later can still apply a box (`handle_left_release`).

## Player-visible
RMB-panning then hitting Escape leaves the camera sliding under the quit menu for as long as the button is held. Starting a select-drag then opening the menu can apply a huge box when LMB is released. C++ stops the pan and aborts the drag the moment OPTIONS fires.
close_reason: OPTIONS stops RMB scroll and cancels LMB drag (C++ LookAtXlat/SelectionXlat)

title: [Select] Click pick is 20wu world proximity not W3D mesh ray
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngineDevice/Source/W3DDevice/GameClient/W3DView.cpp:2183-2233` `W3DView::pickDrawable`: refuse the pick when an opaque (non-`WIN_STATUS_SEE_THRU`) window is under the cursor, build a camera pick ray, and `W3DDisplay::m_3DScene->castRay` against visible render-object geometry (`PickType`). `SelectionXlat.cpp:431` / `:469` uses that drawable pick for hover and double-click; click selection iterates drawables in the pixel region.

## Live
`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/cnc_game_engine/mouse.rs:726-728` `handle_left_click` calls `find_object_at_position` → `selection.rs:240-291` `host_find_object_at_position` → `unit_control.rs:360-435` `pick_object_id_at_world_from_presentation`. That ranks 3D distance from the terrain-ray hit to each object's origin inside `BASE_SELECTION_RADIUS` (20wu) `max` `selection_radius`. Leftover `View::pick_drawable` (closed hq-uyyu) is not this live path. No opaque-GUI walk of `getWindowUnderCursor` on the unit's screen position (`CanSelectDrawable` / `pickDrawable`).

## Player-visible
Clicking the ground next to a unit selects it. Clicking a long vehicle/building mesh far from its origin can miss. Units whose screen position sits under the control bar or another opaque HUD window can still be selected by a world click/box that C++ would refuse.
close_reason: Click/hover pick uses camera mesh ray + opaque HUD refuse (C++ pickDrawable)

title: [Select] Double-click type-select uses 500ms and 10wu not OS click
description:
## C++
`Mouse.cpp:209-214` promotes a device `MBS_DoubleClick` (Win32 `WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK`: `GetDoubleClickTime()` plus `SM_CXDOUBLECLK`/`SM_CYDOUBLECLK`, typically ~4 screen pixels). `MetaEvent.cpp` turns the matching UP into `MSG_MOUSE_LEFT_DOUBLE_CLICK`. `SelectionXlat.cpp:453-521` type-selects only that OS double-click (mass-selectable, locally controlled; Alt = map-wide).

## Live
`mouse.rs:780-807` invents a double-click when `time_delta < 500` ms and world-space `pos_delta < 10.0`. It does not read the OS double-click interval or a pixel slop. The 10wu test is on `mouse_world_position` (terrain hit), so the allowed screen wobble shrinks when zoomed out and grows when zoomed in — the opposite of C++'s fixed pixel rectangle.

## Player-visible
Type-select (double-click a Ranger to grab every Ranger on screen) is pickier than Windows when the camera is far, sloppier when zoomed in, and ignores the user's OS double-click speed. C++ follows the system double-click settings in screen pixels.
close_reason: Type-select double-click uses OS interval and 4px slop, not 500ms/10wu

title: [Select] Quit menu still lets world LMB change selection
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/MessageStream/SelectionXlat.cpp:577-581`: if `TheInGameUI->isQuitMenuVisible()`, `MSG_MOUSE_LEFT_CLICK` is `DESTROY_MESSAGE`. No world selection or context command is processed while the quit/options overlay is up, even for clicks that miss the dialog gadgets.

## Live
`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/cnc_game_engine/input.rs:521-531` runs `handle_left_click` for any InGame/Paused world click that WindowManager did not consume. There is no `is_quit_menu_visible()` gate. Clicks on the dialog gadgets are `wnd_used`; clicks on the 3D world around the dialog still select units and can issue classic-layout context commands. Pause does not disable that path (`in_world` includes `GameState::Paused`).

## Player-visible
With Escape quit menu open, the player can still click units in the exposed map and change the army selection (or fire a context order on release) behind the modal. C++ keeps selection frozen until the menu closes.
close_reason: World LMB is destroyed while quit menu is visible (C++ SelectionXlat)

title: [Cam] Letterbox never lifts live Min/MaxCameraHeight wheel clamp
description:
## C++
`W3DDisplay.cpp:2092-2118` `enableLetterBox(true)` calls `TheTacticalView->setZoomLimited(0)`. `W3DView.cpp:1902-1916` `setHeightAboveGround` clamps to `m_minHeightAboveGround`/`m_maxHeightAboveGround` only when `m_zoomLimited`. `LookAtXlat.cpp:333-348` wheel → `View::zoomIn`/`zoomOut` (`View.cpp:104-112`) changes HAG by 10wu per detent, so cinematic letterbox can zoom closer/farther than GameData Min/MaxCameraHeight.

## Live
`GameClient/.../impl_update.rs:793-802` `apply_presentation_cinematic_letterbox` does call leftover `Display::enable_letter_box`, which sets leftover `View::zoom_limited = false`. The live camera in `mouse.rs:2220-2238` `apply_player_height_zoom_steps` always `(current_hag + steps * 10).clamp(min_h, max_h)` from GameData and never reads leftover `is_zoom_limited()` or `pres.cinematic_letterbox`. Wheel (`:1770-1778`) and held keyboard zoom both use that helper.

## Player-visible
During scripted letterbox (campaign briefings, superweapon cinematics) the player cannot wheel/keyboard-zoom past the normal min/max camera height, and any HAG-based cinematic push is snapped back. C++ unlocks that clamp for the whole letterbox take.
close_reason: Letterbox lifts live Min/MaxCameraHeight wheel clamp via zoom_limited

title: [HUD] GameHUD command strip invents CommandSet-violating buttons
description:
## C++
GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/GUI/ControlBar/ControlBarCommand.cpp:246-323
populateCommand binds CommandSet.ini slots 1-14 exactly (hide empty/SCRIPT_ONLY slots). A Ranger shows only that CommandSet; it does not invent Patrol/Scatter/Attitude/Cheer/Deploy.

## Live
GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/presentation_frame/apply.rs:1267-1638
unit_command_buttons is documented fail-closed: not the CommandSet INI matrix. It invents Stop/AttackMove/Guard/Patrol/Scatter/Attitude/SwitchWeapons/Cheer/Deploy for every mobile, plus name-heuristic specials (Jarmen/Burton/Lotus/CC/airfield), SAMPLE_UPGRADE_COMMANDS on any producer, and Command_PurchaseScience on the unit strip when SPP>0.
GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/ui/hud.rs:819-839 / 1123+ apply those names to GameHUD clicks and letter hotkeys (input.rs GameHUD fallback when leftover WND does not consume).

## Player-visible
Selecting a unit exposes commands that are not on the retail CommandSet (Patrol, Scatter, stance, Cheer, Deploy, PurchaseScience) and omits faction CommandSet cameos that C++ would show in those 14 slots. Hotkeys/clicks on the GameHUD strip can fire those invented commands.
close_reason: GameHUD strip binds CommandSet.ini slots 1-14; no invented Patrol/Scatter/Attitude/Cheer/Deploy/PurchaseScience

title: [ControlBar] Strategy Center Stop OPTION_ONE and ExecuteRailedTransport never restrict
description:
## C++
GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/GUI/ControlBar/ControlBarCommand.cpp:1375-1383, 1488-1503
EXECUTE_RAILED_TRANSPORT is Restricted if there is no DockUpdate or the dock is closed. STOP with OPTION_ONE (Strategy Center artillery stop) is Restricted unless BattlePlanUpdate active plan is PLANSTATUS_BOMBARDMENT.

## Live
GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameClient/src/gui/control_bar/control_bar_impl/impl_command_context.rs:432, 481

close_reason: Live host stamps restrict_a (Stop OPTION_ONE Restricted unless active Bombardment; ExecuteRailedTransport Restricted when dock closed). Leftover get_command_availability + presentation residual wired to C++ ControlBarCommand.cpp:1375-1383,1488-1503.

GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/GUI/ControlBar/ControlBarCommand.cpp:1032-1106, 1361-1372, 1474-1486
