title: [Production] SpawnPoint exits skip DISABLED_HELD and use invented ring not bones
description:
## C++
SpawnPointProductionExitUpdate::exitObjectViaDoor (SpawnPointProductionExitUpdate.cpp:40-88) initializes pristine named bones via Drawable::getPristineBonePositions + Object::convertBonePosToWorldPos (cpp:118-149), snaps Z to terrain layer, sets orientation from bone Get_Z_Rotation, records the occupier slot, then newObj->setDisabled(DISABLED_HELD) so Stinger/Tunnel spawn-point units stay stuck at those bones and cannot be selected or marched away. reserveDoorForExit (cpp:92-108) refuses a new spawn when every bone slot is occupied.

## Live
create_spawn_behavior_child (create_destroy_die.rs:393-417) only create_object + set_orientation — never setDisabled(DISABLED_HELD). spawn_missing_hive_world_soldiers (create_destroy_die.rs:520-578) places Stinger soldiers on host_base_defense::stinger_spawn_point_offsets() — a hardcoded 12wu 120° ring (host_base_defense.rs:979-982, 1094-1099) with atan2 facing, not W3D SpawnPoint bones. Tunnel OneShot RPG troopers use an invented forward*8 + lateral*6 line (create_destroy_die.rs:500-501). Leftover crate spawn_point_production_exit_behavior.rs is not on this live path.

## Player-visible
Stinger Site soldiers and Tunnel Network RPG troopers appear in a geometric ring/line instead of on the model spawn bones, and they are free units the player can select and walk off the building. C++ keeps them HELD on the authored bones so the hive/tunnel garrison layout stays fixed.
close_reason: Live create_spawn_behavior_child setDisabled(DISABLED_HELD); hive/oneshot exits use getPristineBonePositions + convertBonePosToWorldPos + Get_Z_Rotation, snap Z to terrain, occupy bone slots; reserveDoorForExit refuses when every bone is taken. Invented 12wu ring and forward*8 line removed from the player path.

title: [Audio] Construction complete queues VoiceTaskComplete token plus invented BuildingComplete
description:
## C++
`DozerAIUpdate.cpp:597-617` — only if `dozer->isLocallyControlled()`, play authored `getVoiceTaskComplete()` on the dozer. No `"BuildingComplete"` event. Radar event only (`:620`), no radar SFX.

title: [Audio] UnderConstruction loop never plays while dozers build

title: [Audio] Repair and special-power clicks never play VoiceRepair/InitiateSound

## C++
`CommandXlat.cpp:336-339` MSG_DO_REPAIR → PerUnitSound VoiceRepair (`:1773`). `CommandXlat.cpp:637-651` MSG_DO_SPECIAL_POWER* → `spmInterface->getInitiateSound()` (call sites `:1051`, `:1076`, `:1096`).

title: [Audio] Inspect-selecting an enemy plays their VoiceSelect

Left-clicking an enemy tank/building to inspect it plays that enemy's VoiceSelect. C++ is silent.

title: Script science conditions miss host rank-up (acquired / can-purchase / purchase-points)
description:
## C++
Player::addScience (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/Common/RTS/Player.cpp:2503-2551) always TheScriptEngine->notifyOfAcquiredScience. Rank-up addSkillPoints grants rank sciences via addScience, so evaluateScienceAcquired (ScriptConditions.cpp:1543-1553) is an edge trigger on that list (ScriptEngine::isScienceAcquired :7464-7483, removeFromList=TRUE). evaluateCanPurchaseScience (:1559-1568) and evaluateSciencePurchasePoints (:1575-1582, leftover points >= N) read the same Player SPP/science vec the HUD uses.

## Live
eval_player_acquired_science / eval_player_can_purchase_science / eval_player_has_science_purchase_points (scripting/executor/eval_basic.rs:891-1018) read leftover ScriptEngine acquired_sciences and leftover Player SPP/is_capable_of_purchasing_science. Host UI purchase does sync via attempt_to_purchase_science → sync_host_science_to_crate_player (Main game_logic/player.rs:1128-1156, residual wave109:1060-1083 leftover add_science). Host rank-up add_skill_points_limited (player.rs:673-710) only inserts host unlocked_sciences / SPP and record_host_sciences — it never leftover add_science, never notify_of_acquired_science, never sync_host_spp_to_crate_player.

## Player-visible
Scripts gated on player acquired SCIENCE_Rank2/3/4/5, player can purchase <general power>, or player has N science purchase points stay false after the player ranks up (HUD already shows the new rank/points). Rank-gated campaign/challenge unlocks and SPP-gated map scripts never fire unless the player also buys a science (the only leftover sync path).
close_reason: Host rank-up already leftover add_science + notify via sync_leftover_player_sciences_from_host; leftover eval already host-census fallbacks

title: Script conditions PLAYER_HAS_COMPARISON_UNIT_TYPE/KIND_IN_TRIGGER_AREA count 0 on live host
description:
## C++
ScriptConditions::evaluatePlayerHasUnitTypeInArea (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/ScriptEngine/ScriptConditions.cpp:420-497) and evaluatePlayerHasUnitKindInArea walk the player's live Team member lists, test isInside(trigger) and template/kindof, and compare the real count. Used heavily for zone-clear / hold-this-area / sneak-N-units-in objectives.

## Live
eval_player_has_comparison_unit_type_in_trigger_area / eval_player_has_comparison_unit_kind_in_trigger_area (scripting/executor/eval_skirmish.rs:954-1066) use leftover Player::get_all_objects (player/core.rs:285-287 owned_objects) then find_object_by_id. Live host never registers crate objects, so owned_objects is empty and count is always 0. has-at-least-N in area never fires; fewer-than-N / equal-0 fires from map load. Distinct from hq-p46mc (global PLAYER_HAS_OBJECT_COMPARISON / buildings destroyed), which does not cover the trigger-area family.

## Player-visible
Area-hold and infiltrate objectives complete instantly (0 <= N) or never complete (need >= N in the zone). Reinforcement scripts gated on the player having cleared/occupied a trigger area mis-fire for the whole match.
close_reason: Leftover PLAYER_HAS_COMPARISON_UNIT_TYPE/KIND_IN_TRIGGER_AREA now counts live host snapshot objects via host_count_player_type/kind_in_area (C++ evaluatePlayerHasUnitType/KindInArea). Crate Player::get_all_objects path remains fallback.

title: Script conditions ENEMY_SIGHTED / TYPE_SIGHTED stuck false on live host
description:
## C++
ScriptConditions::evaluateEnemySighted (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/ScriptEngine/ScriptConditions.cpp:1029-1080) and evaluateTypeSighted (:1086-1126) resolve the named looker via TheScriptEngine->getUnitNamed, then PartitionManager::iterateObjectsInRange with alive/stealth/map/relationship filters against the real world. True when the named unit sees a matching living unit of the given player (and type for TYPE_SIGHTED).

## Live
eval_enemy_sighted / eval_type_sighted (scripting/executor/eval_named.rs:1680-1786) resolve NamedObjectTracker then TheGameLogic::find_object_by_id / PartitionManager over crate Objects. On the live host OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty so find_object_by_id is None and both conditions return False. No host-snapshot / host-vision fallback exists (unlike NAMED_DESTROYED/INSIDE_AREA).

## Player-visible
Ambush-on-sight, scout-spotted-enemy, and type-spotted triggers never fire. Campaign scripts that spawn defenders or fail stealth sections when a named looker sees the player (or vice versa) stay dead.
close_reason: Leftover ENEMY_SIGHTED/TYPE_SIGHTED now query host vision snapshot when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty (C++ evaluateEnemySighted/TypeSighted). Live inject already fills vision_range + objects; eval_named.rs and leftover ScriptEvaluator dispatch host_enemy_sighted/host_type_sighted.

title: Script condition NAMED_SELECTED stuck false on live host (dual-world fail-closed)
description:
## C++
ScriptConditions::evaluateNamedSelected (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/ScriptEngine/ScriptConditions.cpp:1372-1413) walks TheInGameUI->getAllSelectedDrawables() and compares Object::getName(); false only in multiplayer. Used by campaign/tutorial scripts that wait for the player to select a named unit.

## Live
scripting/executor/eval_named.rs eval_named_selected:508-515 returns False immediately when dual_world_registry_unavailable() (executor/mod.rs:391-392 OBJECT_REGISTRY.is_empty()). The live host never mirrors objects into OBJECT_REGISTRY, so the leftover SelectionManager / drawable walk is never reached and host UI selection is ignored.

## Player-visible
Select-this-unit tutorial/campaign gates never complete. Scripts that reveal the next objective, unhide UI, or start a cinematic after the player clicks a named hero/building stay stuck.
close_reason: NAMED_SELECTED consults host snapshot selected bit when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty (C++ TheInGameUI selected drawables / Object::getName). Multiplayer still false.

title: Sequential UNIT/TEAM scripts never progress on live host (empty registry cleanup / never-idle team)
description:
## C++
ScriptActions UNIT_EXECUTE_SEQUENTIAL_SCRIPT / TEAM_EXECUTE_SEQUENTIAL_SCRIPT queue a SequentialScript; ScriptEngine::evaluateAndProgressAllSequentialScripts (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/ScriptEngine/ScriptEngine.cpp:7860-7918) looks up the real Object/Team, and when AI/AIGroup is idle (or framesToWait==0) advances instructions (move/attack/wait chains). Missing object AND team cleans the node up.

## Live
do_unit_execute_sequential_script (scripting/executor/actions_named.rs:1708-1735) appends a SequentialScript with the NamedObjectTracker id. evaluate_and_progress_all_sequential_scripts (scripting/engine/update.rs:618-711) then TheGameLogic::find_object_by_id — OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty on the live host — so object_arc is None and team_arc is None and the node is cleaned up immediately; unit sequential actions never run. do_team_execute_sequential_script (actions_team_relations.rs:1076-1118) binds the leftover Team (eagerly created). SequentialScript::new sets frames_to_wait=-1 (engine/types.rs:808). team_ai_status on empty dual-world returns idle=false (update.rs:895-899), so team_has_group && team_idle is false and should_progress stays false forever (update.rs:731-734).

## Player-visible
Map-authored sequential scripts (named unit/team walk this waypoint, then attack, then wait) never execute. Campaign intro marches, scripted attack waves, and looping sequential patrols stay idle.
close_reason: Sequential UNIT/TEAM progress looks up host snapshot objects and host team idle instead of cleaning up or stalling on empty leftover OBJECT_REGISTRY.

title: Script condition NAMED_DESTROYED never true after host destroy-list (didUnitExist blocked)
description:
## C++
ScriptConditions::evaluateNamedUnitDestroyed (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/ScriptEngine/ScriptConditions.cpp:274-286) returns theUnit->isEffectivelyDead() while the pointer exists; after processDestroyList the pointer is NULL and TheScriptEngine->didUnitExist(name) keeps the condition TRUE for the rest of the match. Scripts run at the start of the next frame (GameLogic::update ScriptEngine first, destroy list later), so campaign/skirmish hero-death scripts observe didUnitExist, not a still-resident corpse.

## Live
scripting/executor/eval_named.rs eval_named_destroyed:94-139: when OBJECT_REGISTRY is empty it consults host_script_named_unit_alive (scripting/conditions/helpers.rs:156-167). Snapshot objects come from inject_host_script_query_snapshot (Main world_scripts/scripts_camera.rs:247-270, alive = is_alive && !destroyed). After process_destroy_list (world_objects/destroy_list_bounty.rs:141) the unit is gone from host_objects, so named-map and objects miss the name. host_script_query_has_any() is still true, so the evaluator returns False and never falls through to NamedObjectTracker::did_object_exist. Tick order matches C++ (world_tick/step.rs:179 scripts, then :1149 destroy list), so the True window never exists.

## Player-visible
Campaign/skirmish scripts gated on [Named] unit is destroyed (hero-death fail/win, post-kill reinforcement, cleanup chains) never fire after the unit is actually killed. Complementary NAMED_TOTALLY_DEAD is already filed (hq-1rjjs) as true-at-load; this is the opposite polarity on the live path.
close_reason: NAMED_DESTROYED falls through to didUnitExist after host destroy-list removes the name; other live units no longer force False.

title: [Locomotor] Wings idle hold never circles — jets freeze at last waypoint
description:
## C++
`locoUpdate_maintainCurrentPosition` dispatches `LOCO_WINGS` to `maintainCurrentPositionWings` (`Locomotor.cpp:2461-2463`, `2488-2523`). Airborne motive jets aim at the opposite side of `m_circlingRadius` (or min turn radius) and keep flying at `m_minSpeed`. Hover uses `maintainCurrentPositionHover` and stays aloft.

## Live
`update_movement` idle comment says \"Idle hover / wings\" but only Hover calls `loco_maintain_current_position` (`world_tick/movement.rs:529-534`). Wings that reach the last waypoint hit `stop_moving` (`movement.rs:499-505`) and then get Z-only `handleBehaviorZ` with zero velocity. `maintain_position_wings` exists on the object (`object/physics.rs:599-602`) but the live march never invokes it.

## Player-visible
Raptors, Auroras, MiGs, and other wing locos stop dead in the air at a move/attack-move hold instead of circling the hold point at min speed.
close_reason: Wings idle hold calls maintainCurrentPositionWings (motive+above terrain, min_speed circle) from live update_movement instead of stop_moving.

title: [Locomotor] chooseGoodLocomotorFromCurrentSet never runs — cliff/water/rubble loco frozen
description:
## C++
Every `doLocomotor` calls `chooseGoodLocomotorFromCurrentSet` (`AIUpdate.cpp:2114`, `833-868`). That asks `Pathfinder::chooseBestLocomotorForPosition` to pick the set member whose surfaces match the current cell (`AIPathfind.cpp:4722-4731`, `validLocomotorSurfacesForCellType` at `4734-4757`: CLEAR→GROUND|AIR, WATER→WATER|AIR, CLIFF→CLIFF|AIR, RUBBLE→RUBBLE|AIR). Switching locos recomputes group speed and clears precise-Z / no-slow-down.

## Live
Main has a single live movement profile. `resolve_uniform_host_locomotor_set` **rejects** any SET_* row whose members differ in behavior or overlap surfaces (`locomotor_bootstrap.rs:598-630`) because it cannot emulate `chooseGoodLocomotorFromCurrentSet`. There is no `chooseBestLocomotorForPosition` call on the live tick. Surfaces are OR'd once at bind or guessed from the template name (`physics_motion.rs:891-904`).

## Player-visible
Colonel Burton / cliff-capable infantry never switch to the cliff climber loco (no climb anim, no cliff path). Amphibious SET_NORMAL members never swap to the water loco when entering rivers. Rubble-capable locos never activate on destroyed-building cells. Group speed stays wrong after a member should have changed loco.
close_reason: Live doLocomotor calls chooseGoodLocomotorFromCurrentSet; SET_* members bind from INI/lossy attr/known cliff rows (Bike, Burton, Pathfinder, Saboteur).

title: [Locomotor] Hover OVER_WATER model condition never set on live march
description:
## C++
`Locomotor::moveTowardsPositionHover` tests `TheTerrainLogic->isUnderwater` every move and toggles `OVER_WATER` plus `MODELCONDITION_OVER_WATER` (`Locomotor.cpp:1863-1887`). Comment: OverWater is not client-only — it also affects speed.

## Live
Host `update_movement` hover branches only call `handleBehaviorZ` / `loco_maintain_current_position` (`world_tick/movement.rs:520-534`). They never sample the water table or set `over_water`. Leftover `object/update.rs:290-295` is fail-closed: \"no water table — never set over_water true here\" and **clears** the flag if it was set.

## Player-visible
Hover units (Combat Chinook, Helix, hovercraft) over rivers/ocean never switch to the OVER_WATER model (pontoons / water anim) and never get the associated over-water speed change.
close_reason: Live hover march samples water table and toggles OVER_WATER + model condition; leftover fail-closed clear removed.

title: [Locomotor] Live march never applies blocked-wait speed / bumpSpeedLimit
description:
## C++
`AIUpdateInterface::processCollision` marks `m_isBlocked` and computes `m_curMaxBlockedSpeed` (`AIUpdate.cpp:1410-1523`). `doLocomotor` then **caps the move speed before** `locoUpdate_moveTowardsPosition`, decaying `m_bumpSpeedLimit *= 0.95` while blocked and easing it back when clear (`AIUpdate.cpp:2197-2217`). After 1/4 s blocked, `AIInternalMoveToState` clears `MODELCONDITION_MOVING` so the unit looks like it is waiting (`AIStates.cpp:1824-1826`). After 2 s blocked or immediate `isBlockedAndStuck` (other stopped, self not rotating), the path is recomputed (`AIStates.cpp:1796-1800`).

## Live
`update_movement` always integrates toward full `effective_max_speed()` and never reads `is_blocked` / `cur_max_blocked_speed` (`world_tick/movement.rs:314-483`). Collision later calls `apply_blocked_speed_cap` (`world_tick/physics.rs:329-330`) **after** the march, then the next frame's march overwrites velocity again (`world_tick/step.rs:266` then `:797`). `ai_process_collision` never sets `is_blocked_and_stuck` when the other unit is stopped (`object/physics.rs:267-317`); that flag only appears after 30 frames in `clear_blocked_frame_state`.

## Player-visible
Units ram parked allies/enemies at full speed instead of waiting, yielding, or repathing. Traffic jams stay animated as running. Group moves through chokepoints pile up instead of C++ blocked-wait + bump-speed crawl.
close_reason: doLocomotor applies bumpSpeedLimit before march; processCollision sets is_blocked_and_stuck when other is stopped.

title: [Pathfind] LAYER_WALL never classified or searched — infantry cannot walk on structure walls
description:
## C++
`PathfindLayerEnum` reserves `LAYER_WALL = LAYER_LAST = 15` as a dedicated layer so units can run on top of structure walls (`GameType.h:159-167`). `Pathfinder` allocates and classifies that layer from `KINDOF_WALK_ON_TOP_OF_WALL` pieces (`AIPathfind.cpp:4560-4562`, `4126-4153`, `4650-4651`). Destroying a wall piece kills anyone still on `LAYER_WALL` at that cell (`AIPathfind.cpp:4135-4149`).

## Live
Host A* only stores bridge slots `2..=14` (`pathfinding.rs:144-154`, `197-198`). There is no `wall_pieces` list, no `allocateCellsForWallLayer`, and no `LAYER_WALL` search. Crate leftover `pathfind_layer.rs` has the classify helpers but the live host grid never calls them.

## Player-visible
China (and any `WALK_ON_TOP_OF_WALL`) infantry cannot path along player-built walls. Units standing on a wall when it is destroyed do not take the C++ falling/splat kill.
close_reason: Live host LAYER_WALL: allocate/classify (4-corner CLEAR, 1-3 BRIDGE_IMPASSABLE, pinch CLIFF), crate A* search on layer 15, add/remove wall pieces, destroy splat DAMAGE_FALLING/DEATH_SPLATTED.

title: [Audio] SoundMoveStart/Loop never plays when units begin moving
description:
## C++
`AIInternalMoveToState::startMoveSound` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/AI/AIStates.cpp:1666-1704`) plays ThingTemplate `SoundMoveStart` (or damaged variant), else starts looping `SoundMoveLoop` / `SoundMoveLoopDamaged` (`ThingTemplate.cpp:178-181`) on the moving object.

## Live
No `SoundMoveStart` / `SoundMoveLoop` references exist under `GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src`. Live march (`unit_command_move_free` / GameWorld) never queues those events.

## Player-visible
Tanks/trucks/aircraft start and roll without engine-start or move-loop SFX. Only (sometimes missing) VoiceMove would play.
close_reason: Live assign_unit_path_inner/exact plays ThingTemplate SoundMoveStart (or damaged) else loops SoundMoveLoop; stop_moving removes the loop (C++ AIInternalMoveToState::startMoveSound/onExit).

title: [Audio] SoundAmbient never starts on live drawables
description:
## C++
`Drawable::startAmbientSound` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/Drawable.cpp:4437-4541`, also ctor/on-create `:502`, `:1098`, `:1313`) plays ThingTemplate `SoundAmbient` / Damaged / ReallyDamaged / Rubble (`ThingTemplate.cpp:182-185`) as a looping 3D event attached to the drawable. Audio-only map objects (wind, birds) exist with SoundAmbient and no model.

## Live
Host explicitly has no SoundAmbient behavior (`world_objects/spawn_templates.rs:3426-3430`) and skips spawning audio-only map objects that only have `soundambient`. No live drawable start/stop ambient path exists under Main.

## Player-visible
Bases, war factories, power plants, and map ambience (wind/birds/water) are silent. Damaged-building ambient loops never swap in.
close_reason: Live create_object starts ThingTemplate SoundAmbient by body state; damage restart + audio-only map objects seed/spawn; destroy stops the loop (C++ Drawable::startAmbientSound).

title: [Audio] Death/hit drain plays invented UnitDie/WeaponHit not DamageFX
description:
## C++
Hurt/death audio is `ActiveBody::doDamageFX` (`ActiveBody.cpp:297-315,653`) using the object's DamageFX.ini sounds, plus body-state `SoundOnDamaged` / `SoundOnReallyDamaged` (`ActiveBody.cpp:610-621`) and death FXList Sound nuggets. There is no generic UnitDie or WeaponHit event.

## Live
`PresentationFrame::collect_audio_events` (`presentation_frame/apply.rs:672-696`) maps `ObjectDestroyed` → `UnitDie`, lethal `DamageApplied` → `UnitDie`, non-lethal damage → `WeaponHit`. `resolve_audio_event_names` (`host_fx_list_dispatch.rs:160-172`) does not remap those tokens. `should_dispatch_live_audio` only blocks invented `UnitVoice*` and `EVA_*` (`audio_dispatch_impl.rs:320-321`), so UnitDie/WeaponHit are queued. Wave 535 may also play FXList death sounds from particles — UnitDie is extra/wrong.

## Player-visible
Units die/get hit with a missing or generic cue instead of per-weapon DamageFX and per-template SoundOnDamaged. Possible double with death-explosion FXList sounds.
close_reason: Stop inventing UnitDie/WeaponHit; live death/hit is DamageFX + FXList Sound nuggets + SoundOnDamaged.

title: [Audio] Live spend/deposit never play MiscAudio MoneyWithdraw/MoneyDeposit
description:
## C++
`Money::withdraw` / `Money::deposit` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/Common/RTS/Money.cpp:23-56`) play MiscAudio `m_moneyWithdrawSound` / `m_moneyDepositSound` (INI tokens MoneyWithdrawSound / MoneyDepositSound — `INIMiscAudio.cpp:24-25`). AutoDepositUpdate (`AutoDepositUpdate.cpp:102,147`) calls `deposit()` with default playSound=true for oil derricks / black markets. Production and build spend go through withdraw.

## Live
`Player::spend_resources` (`game_logic/game_logic/player.rs:808-836`) mutates supplies with no audio. Oil/black-market/hacker income queues invented names `OilDerrickDeposit` / `OilDerrickCaptureBonus` (`host_oil_derrick.rs:64-68`), `BlackMarketDeposit` (`host_black_market.rs:52`), `HackerCashPing` (`host_hacker_income.rs:59`) via `resources_income.rs:205-210,318-323,441-446,493-498,579-584`. Presentation maps every `EconomyChanged` to invented `MoneyTick` (`presentation_frame/apply.rs:702`). None of these names exist in MiscAudio.ini; leftover `PlayerMoney::withdraw_with_sound` is not on the live host spend path.

## Player-visible
Buying units/buildings is silent (no cash-register withdraw). Oil derrick / black market / hacker ticks do not play MoneyDepositSound. EconomyChanged may enqueue an unresolved MoneyTick.
close_reason: spend_resources/credit_supplies play MoneyWithdrawSound/MoneyDepositSound; oil/bm/hacker no longer invent deposit names; EconomyChanged no longer MoneyTick.

title: [Audio] Dozer place never plays VoiceBuildResponse
description:
## C++
Successful place (`PlaceEventTranslator.cpp:263`) calls `pickAndPlayUnitVoiceResponse(..., MSG_DOZER_CONSTRUCT)` which plays PerUnitSound `VoiceBuildResponse` (`CommandXlat.cpp:449-456`). Illegal place (`PlaceEventTranslator.cpp:274-281`) plays the dozer's `VoiceNoBuild` plus `NoCanDoSound`.

## Live
`execute_build` / `execute_dozer_construct` (`command_executor/construct.rs:26-173`) never call `queue_picked_unit_voice`. Success path in `ui_commands.rs:1649` plays invented `SoundType::Command` (`UnitCommand`). Illegal-place helper `play_illegal_place_feedback_for_id` (`GameClient/src/message_stream/place_event_confirm.rs:147-157`) looks up leftover `TheGameLogic::find_object_by_id` — host dozers are not leftover objects, so VoiceNoBuild is skipped and only a leftover TheAudio NoCanDo beep may fire.

## Player-visible
Placing a building never plays the dozer/worker build-acknowledge line. Illegal terrain plays at most a generic beep, not VoiceNoBuild.
close_reason: Successful dozer place queues VoiceBuildResponse; illegal place plays host VoiceNoBuild + NoCanDoSound.

title: [Audio] Live Command/Select SFX play invented UnitCommand/UnitSelect
description:
## C++
Command feedback is only `pickAndPlayUnitVoiceResponse` (CommandXlat.cpp:271-731) using ThingTemplate VoiceSelect/VoiceMove/VoiceAttack. There is no generic UnitCommand or UnitSelect event. Selection uses VoiceSelect (`:326-329`).

## Live
`host_process_commands_with_command_sound` (`cnc_game_engine/ui_commands.rs:1070-1079`) always plays `SoundType::Command` after a context command. `host_play_sound_effect` (`cnc_game_engine/audio.rs:88-100`) maps that to invented names `UnitCommand` and `UnitSelect` (also ConstructionComplete/UnitReady/WeaponHit/BuildingComplete). Box-select also calls `play_sound_effect(SoundType::Select)` (`mouse.rs:1428-1431`) on top of `select_objects` VoiceSelect (`host_ops_writeback.rs:110-112`). Terrain-fallback move (`mouse.rs:1619-1621`) layers UnitCommand on top of `command_move` VoiceMove.

Those tokens do not exist in MiscAudio.ini / Voice.ini (`resolve_audio_event_names` passes them through unchanged — `host_fx_list_dispatch.rs:160-172`).

## Player-visible
Every context click beeps a generic (or silent-unresolved) UnitCommand instead of / in addition to the unit's voice. Box-select can double: authored VoiceSelect plus UnitSelect beep.
close_reason: C++ pickAndPlay: no invented UnitCommand/UnitSelect; context-click plays VoiceMove/VoiceAttack

title: [Audio] Context-click move/attack never play VoiceMove/VoiceAttack
description:
## C++
`pickAndPlayUnitVoiceResponse` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/MessageStream/CommandXlat.cpp:271-731`) walks the selected drawable list and plays ThingTemplate `VoiceMove` (`:384-412`) for MSG_DO_MOVETO / MSG_DO_ATTACKMOVETO and `VoiceAttack` / `VoiceAttackAir` (`:496-508`) for MSG_DO_ATTACK_OBJECT. Call sites include `:890`, `:1010`. One unit speaks (skip=first for select; last-wins scan for move/attack). Specialty upgrades (VoiceCrush, VoiceSalvage, VoiceMoveUpgraded, VoiceBombard, VoiceDisarm, …) replace the base line in the same function.

## Live
Primary context-click path is `host_queue_and_process_context_click_command` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/cnc_game_engine/mouse.rs:1659-1670`) → `CommandExecutor`. `execute_move` (`command_executor/movement.rs:162-199`), `execute_move_to` (`:202-226`), `execute_attack_move` (`:852-894`), and `execute_group_attack_object` (`command_executor/attack.rs:164-274`) never call `queue_picked_unit_voice`. That helper exists (`host_ops_writeback.rs:1823-1866`) and is used by `GameLogic::command_move` / `command_attack` and by force-move / waypoint / guard only.

## Player-visible
Right-click move, attack-move, and attack on the live host are silent (or only a generic beep — see sibling UnitCommand bead). Rangers/tanks never say their authored Voice.ini lines. Crush/salvage/upgraded-worker/bombard specialty lines never upgrade.
close_reason: C++ pickAndPlay: no invented UnitCommand/UnitSelect; context-click plays VoiceMove/VoiceAttack

title: [HUD] Superweapon ready strip does not flash
description:
## C++
`InGameUI` postDraw (`InGameUI.cpp:3487-3678`) draws each public-timer superweapon at `m_superweaponPosition` (default 0.7, 0.7). When `module->isReady()` (`:3654-3666`):
- if `m_superweaponFlashDuration != 0`, toggle `m_superweaponUsedFlashColor` every `m_superweaponFlashDuration` frames
- `drawName` / `drawTime` use flash color or 0 (default) so READY text blinks
- ready font/bold is applied (`:3626-3629`)
Countdown still shows `m:ss` including `0:00`.

## Live
`camera_drain.rs:2463-2480` stamps presentation timers onto leftover InGameUI. `impl_draw.rs:246-257` draws `{name} {countdown}` at 0.7,0.7 with a **static** yellow `[1,1,0.2]` when `ready` and white otherwise. No flash toggle, no ready-font/bold swap, no `m_superweaponFlashColor` / last-flash-frame.

## Player-visible
When Particle Cannon / Nuke / Scud Storm hits READY, ZH blinks the countdown strip. Live shows a steady yellow `0:00` line. EVA ready voice can still fire from `try_eva_superweapon_ready`; the HUD flash that matches it is missing.
close_reason: Superweapon READY strip flashes like C++ InGameUI

title: [CommandBar] Live availability skips CanMake / prereq / money gray
description:
## C++
`ControlBar::getCommandAvailability` (`ControlBarCommand.cpp:993+`, unit-build case `:1185-1198`):
- `player->canBuild()` false → `COMMAND_RESTRICTED` (prereqs)
- `TheBuildAssistant->canMakeUnit` `MAXED_OUT` / `PARKING_PLACES_FULL` → `COMMAND_RESTRICTED`
- `CANMAKE_NO_MONEY` → `COMMAND_RESTRICTED` (gray; CANT_AFFORD comment unused)
`ControlBar.cpp:3564-3624` applies Restricted / NotReady / CantAfford to the WND button (gray + clock).

## Live
Live host has empty `OBJECT_REGISTRY`, so `ControlBar::get_command_availability` takes the presentation catalog branch (`impl_command_context.rs:208-238`). After hide/disabled/queue-full/clock peels it returns `CommandAvailability::Available` whenever `command_set_name` is set or the object is selectable. It never calls `canMakeUnit` / `canBuild` / money. Presentation `can_make_cameos` (`presentation_frame/build.rs:1411-1492`) only feeds the console `GameHUD` construction panel (`hud.rs:885-893`), not the live WND ControlBar.

## Player-visible
Factory/dozer/upgrade cameos stay fully lit when the player cannot afford them, lacks prereqs, or is at unit cap. Clicks still fail later, but the bar does not gray like ZH. Help-box / BuildTooltip cost-disabled state is also wrong because availability never becomes Restricted.
close_reason: Live WND ControlBar presentation get_command_availability greys CanMake prereq/money/maxed/parking. Dozer construct cameos freeze and match Command_Construct names. Help-box uses stamped CanMake without OBJECT_REGISTRY.

title: [HUD] Live host never runs InGameUI mouseover tooltips
description:
## C++
`SelectionXlat.cpp:425-446` emits `MSG_MOUSEOVER_DRAWABLE_HINT` / `MSG_MOUSEOVER_LOCATION_HINT` on hover. `HintSpy.cpp:26-35` forwards those to `InGameUI::createMouseoverHint` (`InGameUI.cpp:2217-2444`), which:
- sets the unit-name tooltip (ThingTemplate display name)
- appends `TOOLTIP:SupplyWarehouse` dollar value
- suffixes the player name in MP
- remaps `KINDOF_DISGUISER` to the disguise template/color
- remaps `KINDOF_IGNORED_IN_GUI` (AngryMob) to the slaver/nexus
- suppresses `OBJECT:Prop`
- resets tooltip delay when the hover target changes (`:2456-2459`)

## Live
`cnc_game_engine/mouse.rs:2316-2328` (`sync_context_mouse_cursor`) only swaps a winit `CursorIcon`. `create_mouseover_hint` / `create_mouseover_hint_from_presentation` live in leftover `GameClient/.../ingame_ui/impl_input.rs:1311` and `:1500` but have **zero callers** from Main / live host. Catalog is stamped (`camera_drain.rs:2648`) but never consumed for hover tooltips. `ui_render_pass.rs:248-251` still ticks leftover Mouse tooltip draw, so the box stays empty.

## Player-visible
Hovering a unit/building never shows the ZH name/player/warehouse tooltip. Bomb trucks keep their real name. Supply warehouses never show stored-cash value. Props are not specially suppressed because the whole hint path is dead.
close_reason: Live mouseover runs InGameUI createMouseoverHint like C++ SelectionXlat

title: Particles: SMUD* / SMUDGE systems skipped instead of heat-haze smudges
description:
## C++
`W3DParticleSystemManager::doParticles` (W3DParticleSys.cpp:138-172) skips drawable systems, then if the particle type name DWORD is `SMUD` (0x44554D53) it converts each visible particle into `TheSmudgeManager` heat smudges (`addSmudgeToSet`, random UV offset, size, alpha) and continues (does not draw as sprites).
`isUsingSmudge()` is `m_particleType == SMUDGE` (ParticleSys.h:559). The SMUD prefix hack also covers texture-named heat systems.

## Live
`ParticleRenderer::collect_system_particles` (particle_renderer.rs:1307-1316) returns immediately for `ParticleType::Smudge` OR `particle_type_name` prefix `SMUD` — no smudge-manager insert.
Main does draw whatever is already in `get_smudge_manager()` (forward_render.rs:414-427), so the present path exists, but particle systems never feed it.

## Player-visible
Heat-haze / distortion particles (explosion shimmer, jet exhaust SMUD* systems) are invisible. C++ shows screen-space heat smudges; live host drops those systems entirely.
close_reason: Live collect_system_particles feeds SMUD* / Type=SMUDGE into TheSmudgeManager (addSmudgeToSet, random UV, size, alpha) instead of skipping or drawing sprites; Main already presents get_smudge_manager decals.

title: FX: FXListAtBonePos queries empty GameLogic skeleton, not client W3D bones
description:
## C++
`FXListAtBonePosFXNugget::doFXObj` (FXList.cpp:678-686) calls `doFxAtBones` twice (unadorned name, then 01…).
`doFxAtBones` (FXList.cpp:711-728) uses `obj->getDrawable()->getCurrentClientBonePositions` (Drawable.cpp:776-801), which walks W3D `ObjectDrawInterface::getCurrentBonePositions` for the current animated client pose, then `convertBonePosToWorldPos` and `FXList::doFXPos` at each bone.

## Live
Live nugget `FXListAtBonePosFXNugget::do_fx_at_bones` (fx_list.rs:1603-1625) does `primary.get_drawable()` (GameLogic Object, object_queries.rs:793) then `draw.get_bone_local_transform` (GameLogic drawable.rs:2352-2361) on `self.skeleton` / `self.bone_transforms`.
That skeleton is constructed empty (`drawable.rs:1399`) and is not the W3D draw-module pose.
GameClient already has the C++ API (`BasicDrawable::get_current_client_bone_positions`, basic_modules.rs:326-358) but the live FXList runner never calls it.

## Player-visible
FXLists authored with FXListAtBonePos (WeaponFireFXBone, damage bones, etc.) do not spawn at muzzle/hit bones. Nested ParticleSystem / LightPulse / Sound at those bones are missing or appear at the object origin instead of the animated barrel/turret.
close_reason: FXListAtBonePos now queries GameClient BasicDrawable::get_current_client_bone_positions then GameLogic Drawable W3D draw-module walk (C++ Drawable.cpp:776 + W3DModelDraw.cpp:3545). Empty GameLogic skeleton is no longer the bone source.

title: FX: Tracer and RayEffect nuggets never submit on Main present path
description:
## C++
`TracerFXNugget::doFXPos` (FXList.cpp:148-194) creates a GenericTracer drawable, orients it primary→secondary, sets tracer parms, expires after travel.
`RayEffectFXNugget::doFXPos` (FXList.cpp:246-267) calls `TheGameClient->createRayEffectByTemplate` (midpoint drawable + ray system).
Both render in the client 3D scene (W3DTracerDraw Line3D / ray drawable).

## Live
`TracerFXNugget` (fx_list.rs:1204-1235) calls `spawn_tracer_drawable_like_cpp`.
`RayEffectFXNugget` (fx_list.rs:1256-1286) calls `create_ray_effect_by_template` (and also leftover `RayEffectManager::spawn`).
GPU submit exists as `ParticleRenderer::render_tracer_and_ray_fx` (particle_renderer.rs:1096-1151) which bakes tracers + `live_ray_effects()`.
That function is only called from `GameClient::Display::draw` (display.rs:1142) and leftover `w3d/particles.rs:100`.
Host presentation skips Display::draw (`impl_update.rs:55-72`: "No draw_display — Main RenderPipeline is sole present path").
Main `enqueue_client_effect_draw` (forward_render.rs:305-432) draws particles/weather/decals/smudges only — it never calls `render_tracer_and_ray_fx`.
Presentation laser SegLine upload is a different path (object LaserUpdate), not FXList RayEffect/Tracer nuggets.

## Player-visible
Weapon tracer streaks and FXList ray/beam nuggets (particle cannon, lightning, scripted lasers) do not appear on the live host. C++ shows the traveling tracer drawable and the ray between primary/secondary.
close_reason: Main enqueue_client_effect_draw now calls ParticleRenderer::render_tracer_and_ray_fx after particles, matching Display::draw. FXList Tracer/RayEffect submit on the live host present path.

title: FX: LightPulse nuggets never light live TerrainVisual
description:
## C++
`LightPulseFXNugget::doFXPos` / `doFXObj` (FXList.cpp:303-329) call `TheDisplay->createLightPulse` with innerRadius=1.
`W3DDisplay::createLightPulse` (W3DDisplay.cpp:2055-2077) allocates a `W3DDynamicLight` with far attenuation + frame fade.
`HeightMapRenderObjClass::doTheDynamicLight` (HeightMap.cpp:143, called at 643/656/669/682 every terrain VB fill) bakes those lights into terrain vertex diffuse so explosions flash the ground.

## Live
`LightPulseFXNugget::emit_pulse` (fx_list.rs:1314-1322) does create `DisplayDynamicLight` via `create_display_light_pulse` (fx_list.rs:276-315).
`GameClient::update_effects` ticks them (`impl_update.rs:1356`).
GameClient `chunk.rs:347-364` can bake `do_the_dynamic_light` into a leftover chunk VB.
Live Main terrain is `TerrainVisual::record_chunk_draws` (pipeline_prewarm.rs:467 / impl_gpu.rs:808). That path has no `do_the_dynamic_light` / `scene_dynamic_lights` call (no matches under terrain_visual/).

## Player-visible
Weapon / explosion LightPulse nuggets (muzzle flash, bomb flash, death flash) do not light the terrain. Ground stays statically sun-lit while C++ shows a growing/decaying colored pulse around the impact.
close_reason: TerrainVisual::update_chunk_meshes rebakes doTheDynamicLight from createLightPulse scene lights (needs_light_rebake) into live chunk VB colors; shader modulates by baked diffuse.

title: FX: TerrainScorch overlay never rebuilds and draws with road texture, not EXScorch01
description:
## C++
`TerrainScorchFXNugget::doFXPos` (GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameClient/FXList.cpp:426-435) calls `TheGameClient->addScorch`.
`BaseHeightMapRenderObjClass::addScorch` (BaseHeightMap.cpp:2020, 2046) sets `m_scorchesInBuffer = 0`.
`drawScorches` (BaseHeightMap.cpp:146-157) calls `updateScorches()` every frame, then `DX8Wrapper::Set_Texture(0, m_scorchTexture)` where `m_scorchTexture = NEW ScorchTextureClass` (BaseHeightMap.cpp:1862) loads `EXScorch01.tga` (TerrainTex.cpp:1058-1060).

## Live
`TerrainScorchFXNugget::do_fx_pos` (GeneralsRust/Code/GameEngine/GameClient/src/fx_list.rs:1467-1481) only calls `add_terrain_scorch`.
`add_terrain_scorch` (scorch_mesh.rs:275-279) pushes into the global buffer and sets `scorches_in_buffer = 0`, but never sets TerrainVisual `overlay_gpu_meshes_dirty`.
`update_road_meshes` (terrain_visual/impl_gpu.rs:540-542) returns immediately unless that dirty flag is set, so `update_scorch_meshes` (impl_gpu.rs:719-747) does not run after combat scorches.
When a mesh eventually exists, `record_road_draws` (impl_gpu.rs:946-971) draws scorch meshes with `road_texture_bind_group`, not EXScorch01.
Main presents this via `record_chunk_draws` (pipeline_prewarm.rs:467). Distinct from hq-m6kfy (invented extra decal).

## Player-visible
Explosion / death TerrainScorch marks do not appear on the ground after the shot. If an overlay rebuild later occurs (map load, road lighting), the marks show as road-texture tiles instead of the 3x3 EXScorch burn atlas.
close_reason: addScorch zeros scorches_in_buffer; TerrainVisual update rebuilds overlay independently of overlay_gpu_meshes_dirty and record_road_draws binds EXScorch01, not road texture.

title: [Garrison] ReallyDamaged buildings stay occupiable and never eject garrison
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Contain/GarrisonContain.cpp`:
- `isValidContainerFor` (`529-542`): reject if health <= 0, and reject if `BODY_REALLYDAMAGED` unless `KINDOF_GARRISONABLE_UNTIL_DESTROYED` (Firebase/bunker exception).
- `onBodyDamageStateChange` (`1724-1732`): on the edge into `BODY_REALLYDAMAGED`, `orderAllPassengersToExit(CMD_FROM_AI, FALSE)` so occupants walk out of a collapsing civilian/faction building.

## Live
`GameLogic::can_unit_enter_normal_target` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/object_queries.rs:845-873`) is the live Enter authority. It checks alive/sold/construction/subdued/admission/slots — **not** `body_damage_state` and **not** `KindOf::GarrisonableUntilDestroyed`.
Arrival (`support_states.rs:3281`) reuses that same check.
No live damage/body-state path calls evacuate when a garrison building crosses ReallyDamaged (`object/damage.rs` has no garrison eject).

## Player-visible
Infantry can garrison (and keep firing from) a building that is already in the ReallyDamaged pose. C++ refuses new entries and forces occupants out so the wreck cannot be used as a bunker. Firebases tagged `GARRISONABLE_UNTIL_DESTROYED` are supposed to be the exception; live treats every garrison the same.
close_reason: ReallyDamaged buildings reject/eject garrison like C++ GarrisonContain

title: [Transport] Unload/Evacuate teleports passengers Idle in a ring instead of walking ExitStart/ExitEnd
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Contain/OpenContain.cpp:915-1028` `OpenContain::exitObjectViaDoor`:
- Looks up authored `ExitStart`/`ExitEnd` (or numbered `ExitStart01`… cycling `m_whichExitPath`).
- Places the rider at the start bone, matches container layer/orientation, `aiFollowPath` along end bone (+ rally if set).
- `TransportContain::onRemoving` (`TransportContain.cpp:306-378`) further applies `ExitBone`, `OrientLikeContainerOnExit`, `KeepContainerVelocityOnExit`, and airborne `setAllowToFall`.

## Live
The live player Exit/Evacuate path is `execute_exit` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/command_executor/transport.rs:356-475`):
- Invents a 6-unit ring around the hull/rally (`angle = sin/atan2`, offset * 6).
- `unit_command_exit_drop` (`unit_commands.rs:1237-1257`) teleports to that point, `stop_moving`, `AIState::Idle`.
- `walk_unit_via_open_contain_exit` (`drones_and_garrison.rs:1278-1327`) already implements ExitStart/End + follow-path, but is only used when kicking other-player occupants — not player unload.
- Move-to-and-evac arrival `evacuate_container_now` (`registries.rs:731-738`) also teleports transports to an 8-unit ring and sets Idle.

## Player-visible
Unloading a Humvee/Chinook/Battle Bus/Troop Crawler pops infantry in a ring around the hull and they stand still. C++ has them walk out the ramp/door bones (and keep hull velocity when jumping from a moving/airborne transport). Ramps and multi-exit cycling never play.
close_reason: Live execute_exit / evacuate_container_now walk ExitStart/End (aiFollowPath) instead of Idle 6-unit ring. NumberOfExitPaths cycles ExitStart0N. Airborne setAllowToFall + hull motive.

title: [Garrison] Evacuate/Exit teleports occupants to a 6-unit ring instead of C++ burst/left/right walk-out
description:
## C++
`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Contain/GarrisonContain.cpp:1473-1585` `GarrisonContain::exitObjectViaDoor`:
- Does **not** use OpenContain ExitStart/End.
- `EVAC_TO_LEFT` / `EVAC_TO_RIGHT` (`1512-1554`): random door pocket on the building side, then `aiFollowPath` to a spread walk-to point (`minorRadius * 10`).
- Default `EVAC_BURST_FROM_CENTER` (`1557-1579`): enclosing occupants snap to cliff-adjusted building origin / ground Z, then `aiFollowPath` to `adjustToPossibleDestination`.
- Script `doNamedSetGarrisonEvacDisposition` selects left/right/burst.

## Live
Player Evacuate/Exit on a garrison building goes through `CommandExecutor::execute_exit` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/command_executor/transport.rs:215-527`), which:
- Builds a 6-unit ring offset around rally/building origin (`356-359`).
- Calls `unit_command_exit_drop` (`472-475` → `GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/unit_commands.rs:1237-1257`) which **teleports** the occupant to that point and sets `AIState::Idle`.
- Never reads `garrison_evac_disposition` and never calls `walk_unit_via_open_contain_exit` (`drones_and_garrison.rs:1278-1327`).
- `evacuate_container_now` (`registries.rs:677-730`) does implement burst/left/right walk, but only for move-to-and-evac arrival — not the Evacuate button / MSG_EXIT path.

## Player-visible
Clicking Evacuate or Exit on a garrisoned bunker/building pops infantry in a tight 6-unit ring and they stand Idle. C++ has them burst from the building center or peel left/right and walk out. Scripted left/right evac dispositions are ignored on the live command path.
close_reason: Live execute_exit/execute_evacuate garrison path now calls garrison_exit_occupant_via_door (burst/left/right walk) instead of the 6-unit Idle ring. Classification uses is_garrison_contain, not KINDOF_STRUCTURE.

title: Scatter-miss splash invents 1.5x secondary radius on XZ
description:
## C++
dealDamageInternal (Weapon.cpp:1271-1438) uses authored getPrimaryDamageRadius(bonus) / getSecondaryDamageRadius(bonus) and DAMAGE_RANGE_CALC_TYPE = FROM_BOUNDINGSPHERE_3D. Amount is primary inside primaryRadiusSqr else secondary. No invented 1.5x ring.

## Live
apply_scatter_miss_splash_at (world_tick/shock.rs:426-429) sets secondary_r = splash_radius * 1.5 and tests XZ dx/dz only (shock.rs:457-459), not bounding-sphere 3D.

## Player-visible
Missed grenades/flashbangs/scatter shells damage a 50% larger ground ring than Weapon.ini SecondaryDamageRadius, including units whose 3D sphere is outside the blast.
close_reason: apply_scatter_miss_splash_at uses authored Primary/SecondaryDamageRadius and FROM_BOUNDINGSPHERE_3D; no invented 1.5x XZ ring

title: Projectile splash shockwave nudges position instead of physics stun
description:
## C++
dealDamageInternal fills DamageInfo shockWaveAmount/Radius/TaperOff (Weapon.cpp:1413-1430). Object::attemptDamage (Object.cpp:1801-1835) applies PhysicsBehavior::applyShock, applyRandomRotation, setStunned(true), and MODELCONDITION_STUNNED_FLAILING for non-airborne non-projectiles.

## Live
CombatSystem area detonation (combat.rs:1871-1888) invents a one-frame XZ position nudge (strength*0.02, cap 12) plus a velocity kick. It never calls Object::apply_shock_wave_impulse (object/physics.rs:60-112), which is the C++ stun/flail/toss residual used only by world_tick/shock.rs instant-hit splash.

## Player-visible
Artillery/missile/MOAB-style ShockWaveAmount detonations slide units a few cells instead of tossing them and locking STUNNED_FLAILING for ~1.5s.
close_reason: CombatSystem area detonation calls apply_shock_wave_impulse (stun/STUNNED_FLAILING) instead of one-frame XZ position nudge

title: Sold and under-construction units can still fire
description:
## C++
Object::isAbleToAttack (Object.cpp:3171-3176) returns false when OBJECT_STATUS_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION or OBJECT_STATUS_SOLD. Base defenses and sold buildings cannot discharge.

## Live
Object::can_attack (object/bonuses.rs:675-693) checks alive/weapon/disabled/shock/jammed/docked only — not status.under_construction or status.sold. fire_at_ex (object/attack.rs:53-56) only blocks weapons_jammed / is_disabled. Combat callers (host_ops_writeback.rs:1745, missile_defenders.rs:1535) use can_attack().

## Player-visible
Patriots/Stingers/Gattling can shoot while the building is still going up. Selling a defense does not stop it from firing.
close_reason: can_attack/can_fire/fire_at_ex reject OBJECT_STATUS_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION and SOLD (Object.cpp:3171-3176).

title: Splash RadiusDamageAffects uses name heuristic not Weapon.ini
description:
## C++
WeaponTemplate default m_affectsMask is ALLIES|ENEMIES|NEUTRALS (Weapon.cpp:271). INI RadiusDamageAffects overwrites via TheWeaponAffectsMaskNames (Weapon.h:98-107), including NOT_AIRBORNE (WEAPON_DOESNT_AFFECT_AIRBORNE). dealDamageInternal (Weapon.cpp:1275-1373) uses getAffectsMask(); airborne skip is curVictim->isSignificantlyAboveTerrain() (Weapon.cpp:1351). Primary victim ignores the mask.

## Live
fire_at_ex (object/attack.rs:249-254) and apply_instant_hit_splash_at (world_tick/shock.rs:309-311) call host_radius_damage_affects_for_weapon_name → seed_radius_damage_affects_for (weapon_bootstrap/collide.rs:83-126). That seed never sets WEAPON_DOESNT_AFFECT_AIRBORNE, defaults to ENEMIES|NEUTRALS (no ALLIES), and guesses ALLIES from name substrings (scud/nuke/moab/…). Airborne test is KindOf::Aircraft || airborne_target (combat.rs:1821-1822), not is_significantly_above_terrain. Leftover store already parses affects_mask from Weapon.ini (weapon_template.rs:2633) but live fire ignores it.

## Player-visible
Default splash never friendly-fires (C++ does unless INI clears ALLIES). Neutron/poison/microwave NOT_AIRBORNE is ignored so landed vs flying victims are wrong. Named heuristics mis-tag ally/self/suicide masks vs authored INI.
close_reason: Live splash reads Weapon.ini RadiusDamageAffects from leftover store; seed no longer name-heuristics; airborne is isSignificantlyAboveTerrain

title: WeaponBonus PLAYER_UPGRADE/FANATICISM flags never multiply live fire
description:
## C++
Weapon::computeBonus (Weapon.cpp:1797-1816) ORs source->getWeaponBonusCondition() then TheGlobalData->m_weaponBonusSet->appendBonuses. WeaponBonusUpgrade.cpp:67 sets WEAPONBONUSCONDITION_PLAYER_UPGRADE. GameData WeaponBonus PLAYER_UPGRADE DAMAGE is 125% (Uranium Shells, AP Bullets, Chain Guns, AP Rockets). FANATICISM (Weapon.h:180) stacks extra ROF on Infantry General while NATIONALISM is set. Both flags are applied on every fire via getPrimaryDamage(bonus)/getDelayBetweenShots(bonus).

## Live
Object::weapon_bonus_player_upgrade and weapon_bonus_fanaticism are stored (object/mod.rs:994-996, 2172-2174) and set by upgrade/horde residuals, but Object::weapon_bonus_fields (object/bonuses.rs:154-249) never reads either flag. fire_at_ex (object/attack.rs:184) uses effective_weapon_damage → weapon_bonus_fields().0 only.

## Player-visible
Researched Uranium Shells / AP Bullets / Chain Guns / AP Rockets deal 100% damage instead of 125%. Infantry General Fanaticism ROF never stacks on top of Nationalism.
close_reason: weapon_bonus_fields applies PLAYER_UPGRADE DAMAGE 125% and FANATICISM ROF 125% stacked on NATIONALISM.

title: [Stealth] Detected stealthed units skip heat-vision second material pass
description:
## C++
`StealthUpdate::calcStealthedStatusForPlayer` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/StealthUpdate.cpp:497-502`) returns `STEALTHLOOK_VISIBLE_DETECTED` (enemy) or `STEALTHLOOK_VISIBLE_FRIENDLY_DETECTED` (ally) when STEALTHED+DETECTED. `update` applies that look (`:809-810`). Detector first-spot also forces `Drawable::setSecondMaterialPassOpacity(1.0)` except mines (`StealthDetectorUpdate.cpp:284-290`). Destalth with HintDetectableConditions sets the same second pass for the local owner (`StealthUpdate.cpp:407-420`). Heat vision is the player cue that a unit is detected-stealth, not a normal visible unit.

## Live
Presentation mesh pass (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/presentation_frame/queries.rs:349-365`) applies friendly pulse opacity only when `local_viewer_uses_friendly_stealth_look`. Detected enemies stay at default `presentation_opacity = 1.0` (`unit_render.rs:428`) with no second-material/heat-vision pass. Detector mark (`stealth_mines.rs:1094-1123`) never sets `camo_heat_vision_opacity`. The only heat-vision write is CamoNetting structures with a hardcoded enemy observer (`stealth_mines.rs:478-491`), not per-local-player StealthLook.

## Player-visible
A detected Pathfinder / Burton / Rebel / mine-except stealth unit looks like an ordinary fully-opaque mesh. Retail draws the heat-vision overlay until detection expires. Own destalthed stealth units also never get the HintDetectable heat hint while firing.
close_reason: Detected stealthed units now set heat-vision second-material opacity (mines skipped). Presentation mesh pass applies local-player StealthLook heat overlay; destalth HintDetectable fires for the local owner.

title: [Stealth] Bomb truck disguise halfpoint skips DisguiseStarted/FX and reveal FX
description:
## C++
`StealthUpdate::changeVisualDisguise` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/StealthUpdate.cpp:960-1096`) at the transition halfpoint: plays per-unit `DisguiseStarted` and `FXList::doFXPos(m_disguiseFX)` when gaining disguise (`:1010-1016`); on reveal plays `DisguiseRevealedSuccess` if there is a current victim else `DisguiseRevealedFailure`, plus `m_disguiseRevealFX` (`:1071-1084`). Model swap, indicator color, and radar re-add happen in the same call.

## Live
`PendingSpecialAbility::DisguiseAsVehicle` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_objects/support_states.rs:5046-5095`) calls `apply_disguise` and immediately queues voice `BombTruckVoiceDisguise` only. `Object::tick_disguise_transition` (`object/stealth.rs:87-147`) swaps template/team at halfpoint with no audio and no `FX_BombTruckDisguise`. Reveal in `update_stealth_and_detection` (`stealth_mines.rs:125-139`) queues only `BombTruckVoiceModeDisguise`. `FX_BombTruckDisguise` / `FX_BombTruckDisguiseReveal` / `DisguiseStarted` / `DisguiseRevealedSuccess|Failure` are constants in `host_bomb_truck_disguise.rs:56-64` and are never dispatched.

## Player-visible
Bomb truck disguise/reveal has no smoke/flash FX at the model-swap midpoint. Start sound is the command voice at order time, not the per-unit DisguiseStarted cue at halfpoint. Reveal never plays success vs failure disguise stingers or reveal FX.
close_reason: Bomb truck disguise halfpoint now plays DisguiseStarted + FX_BombTruckDisguise; reveal halfpoint plays DisguiseRevealedSuccess/Failure + FX_BombTruckDisguiseReveal. Removed premature reveal voice at transition start.

title: [Stealth] Detector scan never plays IR ping, loud ping, or IR particles
description:
## C++
`StealthDetectorUpdate::update` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/StealthDetectorUpdate.cpp:338-394`) after each DetectionRate wake, if the detector is locally visible (`getShroudedStatus <= OBJECTSHROUD_PARTIAL_CLEAR`) and not stealthed-to-the-local-player: attaches IR / IRBright ping particles on `IRParticleSysBone`, attaches IRBeacon (`IRLenzflare`), and plays `m_loudPingSound` when anyone was spotted else `m_pingSound` (`IRPing` / `IRPingLoud` on Listening Outpost / Troop Crawler / Sentry / Pathfinder). Grid particles also spawn on each newly spotted target (`:292-308`).

## Live
`GameLogic::update_stealth_and_detection` detector pass (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/world_scripts/stealth_mines.rs:915-1124`) marks detected and fires discover/neutralize radar+message (`:1122-1123`, `:1252-1351`) but never queues `IRPing` / `IRPingLoud` or IR/beacon/grid particle systems. Constants exist only as unused residuals (`host_listening_outpost.rs:43-47`, `host_troop_crawler.rs`).

## Player-visible
Listening Outpost, Sentry Drone, Pathfinder, and Troop Crawler scans are silent and have no IR lens-flare / ping burst. Retail detectors click every DetectionRate (900ms / 500ms) whenever the player can see them; live they never do.
close_reason: Detector DetectionRate scans now queue IRPing/IRPingLoud, IRLenzflare beacon, IRDetectPing/Bright, and IRDetectGrid on newly spotted targets when the detector is locally visible and not stealthed-to-local.

title: [Stealth] Generic grant recloak ignores StealthLevel bits (move / black market / riders)
description:
## C++
`StealthUpdate::allowedToStealth` (`GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/StealthUpdate.cpp:234-401`) destalths when the unit's StealthLevel bits forbid cloak: MOVING (`:390-392`), NO_BLACK_MARKET (`:280-291`), RIDERS_ATTACKING (`:376-384`), TAKING_DAMAGE (`:299-310`), plus fire/ability bits. Only after that check fails does `update` (`:737-751`) clear STEALTHED and arm `m_stealthAllowedFrame = now + stealthDelay`. Recloak (`:717-735`) runs only when `allowedToStealth` is true again.

## Live
`GameLogic::update_stealth_and_detection` applies per-unit destalth (Pathfinder `:143-175`, Sentry `:177-228`, Listening Outpost `:231-280`, CamoNetting `:343-430`) then a later GPS/receiveGrant residual (`:884-912`) recloaks **every** `innate_stealth && !stealthed` unit via `Object::try_recloak_after_stealth_delay` (`GeneralsRust/Code/Main/src/game_logic/object/stealth.rs:286-307`). Forbidden is only attacking / using-ability (`stealth_mines.rs:902-910`). MOVING, NO_BLACK_MARKET, RIDERS_ATTACKING, and TAKING_DAMAGE are ignored. Default `stealth_delay_frames` is 0 (`object/construct.rs:885`), so Pathfinder / LO / CamoNetting destalth and recloak in the same frame.

## Player-visible
- Pathfinder never stays visible while marching (StealthDelay 0 + MOVING destalth undone same tick).
- Listening Outpost stays cloaked while moving or while Tank Hunter riders fire.
- GLA CamoNetting buildings stay cloaked after the Black Market dies (or after taking damage).
- Sentry Drone destalths on move, then the grant path recloaks after 60 frames even if still moving (cloak flicker every ~2s).
close_reason: Grant recloak now honors StealthLevel bits: MOVING, TAKING_DAMAGE, NO_BLACK_MARKET, RIDERS_ATTACKING plus fire/ability. Pathfinder/LO/CamoNetting destalth is no longer undone the same frame.

title: [Mines] Dozer/Worker mine-clear silently deletes enemy demo traps
description:
## C++
DemoTrapUpdate: effectively-dead + DetonateWhenKilled=Yes detonates DemoTrapDetonationWeapon. GLADemoTrap is STRUCTURE not KINDOF_MINE so disarm cannot target it.

## Live
can_clear_mine_kind includes DemoTrap; clear_mine_internal destroys silently.

## Player-visible
Enemy dozer/worker removes GLA demo traps for free; C++ trap detonates when killed.
close_reason: Dozer/Worker DISARM no longer silent-deletes GLA demo traps: can_clear_mine_kind excludes DemoTrap (STRUCTURE/KINDOF_DEMOTRAP, not KINDOF_MINE). clear_mine_internal refuses. Killing still DetonateWhenKilled.

title: [Mines] Cluster Mines SmartBorder lays one extra ring
description:
## C++
GenerateMinefieldBehavior SmartBorder do-while places ring then expands; loops while expanded radius < DistanceAroundObject → outer 73.

## Live
smart_border_mine_positions places the ring BEFORE the >=distance_around break → extra ring at 89.

## Player-visible
Cluster Mines field ~40% denser and larger than retail.
close_reason: SmartBorder place-then-expand: check radius after expand so Cluster Mines outer ring is 73 not 89.

title: [Mines] Land mines never trip on geometry contact
description:
## C++
MinefieldBehavior is a CollideModuleInterface: collision fires onCollide when victim geometry touches the mine footprint (mine r~8 + victim geometry).

## Live
Only trip path is update_mines_and_demo_traps center-distance <= trigger_range 8.0. Collide dispatch never runs MinefieldBehavior::onCollide.

## Player-visible
Vehicles crossing China mine rings only blow a pad when their CENTER is within 8 units. Mines spaced 16 apart leave live gaps.
close_reason: Land mines trip on MinefieldBehavior::onCollide geometry contact (mine r~8 + victim geometry), not center-distance <= 8. Vehicles crossing 16-spaced rings no longer leave live gaps.

title: Epic: Sixteenth C++/Rust live-host gap hunt
description: Compare GeneralsMD (C++) to GeneralsRust live host (Code/Main) and leftover GameEngine ports. Register every player-visible behavioral difference. Only allowed difference: wgpu replacing DirectX. GameNetwork out of scope. Then fix all registered issues and re-hunt until zero remain.

title: [Garrison] Occupant auto-fire acquires undetected stealthed enemies
description:
## C++
Garrisoned occupants acquire via AI/partition filters and cannot auto-target undetected stealth.

## Live
try_garrison_residual_fire candidate loop omits the effectively_stealthed skip. Transport path has it via pick_nearest_residual_target.

## Player-visible
Garrisoned bunker occupants auto-fire at stealthed Jarmen/rebels that retail lets sneak past.
close_reason: try_garrison_residual_fire now skips effectively_stealthed candidates (parity with pick_nearest_residual_target / C++ acquire filters). Detected stealth remains legal.

title: [Garrison] Occupant fire uses raw weapon range missing GARRISONED 133%
description:
## C++
GarrisonContain/HelixContain onContaining set WEAPONBONUSCONDITION_GARRISONED. Weapon::isWithinAttackRange uses getAttackRange with GameData GARRISONED RANGE 133%.

## Live
try_garrison_residual_fire gates dist > weapon.range (raw). Helix infantry via try_transport_passenger_residual_fire also uses raw range and Docked state so host bonus never applies.

## Player-visible
Garrisoned RPG/Missile Defenders engage at base range instead of ~33% farther.
close_reason: try_garrison_residual_fire uses Object::effective_weapon_range (WEAPONBONUSCONDITION_GARRISONED RANGE 133%). Helix infantry residual fire multiplies raw range by 1.33 because occupants stay Docked so the Garrisoned AIState bonus never applies.

title: FX: authored weapon FireFX/DetonationFX particle systems spawn twice (mirror + FXList dispatch)
description: C++: WeaponTemplate::fireWeaponTemplate plays the FireFX FXList exactly once; FXList.cpp:502-529 reallyDoFX creates one ParticleSystem per ParticleSystem nugget. Live: Main/src/game_logic/combat_particles.rs spawn_weapon_fire_fx_named_ocl — when the FireFX/DetonationFX name is an authored FXList, it (a) spawns EACH authored ParticleSystem-template name via spawn_with_template -> mirror_spawn_to_client_manager -> ParticleSystemManager::create_preset_system_xyz, which resolves the authored retail template (ensure_preset_template find_template hit) and creates a REAL system in the live GameClient manager, then (b) also calls dispatch_fx_list_at_pos_ex(fx,...) whose ParticleSystem nuggets (fx_list.rs ParticleSystemWrapper -> manager.create_particle_system) create the SAME systems again. Muzzle side doubles every template in the list; impact side doubles the first template. C++ creates each exactly once. Player-visible: doubled muzzle flashes/impact bursts (denser, brighter) for every weapon with authored Weapon.ini FireFX/ProjectileDetonationFX, plus doubled particle-budget pressure. Fix direction: mirror-markers only when the FXList dispatch runner is absent (dispatch_fx_list_at_pos_ex already returns whether a manager ran). / live: both paths run unconditionally in the same call; stores populated by shell FXList.ini load + init_fx_list_store
close_reason: FireFX/DetonationFX play FXList once: host marker only, no spawn_with_template client mirror; dispatch_fx_list creates ParticleSystems.

title: FX: TerrainScorch nugget double-draws an invented 2-minute decal quad over the terrain scorch
description: C++: FXList.cpp:426-440 TerrainScorchFXNugget::doFXPos calls only TheGameClient->addScorch -> W3DGameClient::addScorch -> TheTerrainRenderObject->addScorch (W3DGameClient.cpp:110-118). Exactly one terrain mark, no decal. Live: GameClient/src/fx_list.rs TerrainScorchFXNugget::do_fx_pos calls BOTH terrain::scorch_mesh::add_terrain_scorch AND with_decal_manager(DecalSettings::scorch_mark) — a solid brown (0.2,0.1,0.0) alpha-0.8 quad with 120s lifetime + 10s fade (effects/decals.rs:61) rendered via forward_render.rs render_decals. The registered scorch hook (core/game_client/impl_init.rs:590-598) adds the same extra decal on the hook path. The terrain scorch itself already renders (terrain_visual/impl_gpu.rs:713/724 bake + road draw pass), so every explosion scorch appears doubled/darker and wrongly flat-colored for 2 minutes; also the terrain scorch quads sample the road texture bind group (impl_gpu.rs:950) rather than a scorch atlas. / leftover: fx_list.rs:1509-1523, decals.rs / live: decal pass is live-registered (impl_init.rs:587-588)
close_reason: TerrainScorch calls add_terrain_scorch only; removed invented DecalSettings::scorch_mark quad from fx_list, fxlist_integration, and scorch hook.

title: Particles: IsGroundAligned systems camera-billboard instead of lying flat
description: C++: W3DParticleSys.cpp:308 renders each system via m_pointGroup->Set_Billboard(sys->shouldBillboard()) (ParticleSys.h:562 shouldBillboard=!m_isGroundAligned) — IsGroundAligned Yes systems draw as flat world-XY quads lying on the terrain (this is why AREA_EFFECT field particles get the separate field-particle budget, ParticleSys.cpp:1685). Live: GameClient/src/effects/particle_renderer.rs collect_system_particles never reads info.is_ground_aligned / system.should_billboard(), and shaders/particle_vertex.wgsl always offsets corners by view-inverse right/up — every particle camera-billboards. Player-visible: GLA toxin/poison fields, radiation/area-effect ground systems (all IsGroundAligned Yes retail systems) stand up as camera-facing sprites instead of lying on the ground; orientation wrong at any camera pitch. / leftover: GameClient/src/effects/particle_system.rs:1860 should_billboard exists but has zero renderer consumers / live: forward_render.rs enqueue_client_effect_draw -> render_particles -> collect_system_particles (live path)
close_reason: IsGroundAligned systems now lie flat via should_billboard on live collect_system_particles + vertex shader

title: [Audio] CommandButton UnitSpecificSound never plays on button activation
description: C++: ControlBarCommandProcessing.cpp:183-189 — every command-button activation plays AudioEventRTS sound = *commandButton->getUnitSpecificSound() with sound.setPlayerIndex(local player) then TheAudio->addAudioEvent(&sound), before the command is dispatched. Retail CommandButton.ini defines UnitSpecificSound on 39 buttons (extracted from INIZH.big): mode voices like BlackLotusVoiceModeBuilding/Vehicle/Cash, JarmenKellVoiceModeSnipe, ColonelBurtonVoiceModeKnife/TimedCharge/RemoteCharge, CIAAgentVoiceMode*, BombTruckVoiceModeDisguise/BioBomb/HiEx, OverlordTankVoiceModeGattling/SpeakerTower/Bunker, HelixVoiceMode*(incl NapalmBomb/NuclearBomb), ComancheVoiceModeRocketPods, MissileDefenderVoiceModeLaser, DragonTankVoiceModeFireStorm, ToxinTractorVoiceModeContam, AmbulanceVoiceModeDetox, RebelVoiceModeBoobyTrap, Demo*VoiceModeDemo. Live: GameClient control bar parses and stores unit_specific_sound (Common ini_command_button.rs:331, GameClient control_bar/mod.rs:261 + impl_buttons.rs:234) but never plays it; Main's control-bar bridge instead plays SoundType::Command which maps to invented name 'UnitCommand' (cnc_game_engine/audio.rs:94) that exists in no retail INI, resolves to nothing (SoundEffectsTable miss / TheAudio AHSV_Error), so it is silent. No general UnitSpecificSound playback exists anywhere in Main (only one-off residuals like FIREWALL_ACTIVATE_AUDIO). Player-visible: clicking ability/mode buttons (Lotus hack modes, Kell snipe, Burton charges, BombTruck bomb select, Overlord/Helix mounts, Comanche rocket pods, Laser Missiles, firewall, detox, booby trap) gives no voice feedback in C++ but silence on the live host. Fix shape: on live host control-bar button accept (and GameClient button processing), play the parsed unit_specific_sound event with the local player index, matching ControlBarCommandProcessing.
close_reason: Command-button activation plays UnitSpecificSound with local player index before dispatch (processCommandUI + live issue_named_command_from_ui).

title: [Audio] Radar online/offline queues RadarOnline/RadarOffline; retail MiscAudio maps to RadarOn/RadarOff so it never plays
description: C++: Player::addRadar/removeRadar/disableRadar/enableRadar (Player.cpp:3132-3203) play TheAudio->getMiscAudio()->m_radarOnlineSound / m_radarOfflineSound via addAudioEvent with setPlayerIndex(getPlayerIndex()) gated by okToPlayRadarEdgeSound (not defeated/dead, client not quiet, frame>0). Retail MiscAudio.ini: RadarNotifyOnlineSound = RadarOn, RadarNotifyOfflineSound = RadarOff (verified by extracting Data/INI/MiscAudio.ini from INIZH.big). Retail SoundEffects.ini defines AudioEvent RadarOn (gradarup) and RadarOff (gradardn), Volume 45, Limit 1, Type = ui player. No RadarOnline/RadarOffline events exist in any retail INI. Live: Main/src/game_logic/host_radar.rs:36-39 hardcodes RADAR_ONLINE_AUDIO='RadarOnline' / RADAR_OFFLINE_AUDIO='RadarOffline'; both live transition paths queue those names (world_objects/crates_radar_power.rs:887-893 update_player_radar brownout/CC path; gameworld_shadow/session.rs:2045-2065 host_player_radar_log drain). SoundEffectsTable.resolve_sound_path('RadarOnline'|'RadarOffline') returns None and Common TheAudio find_audio_event_info misses (AHSV_Error), so the request is silently dropped. Leftover GameLogic Player add_radar/remove_radar/enable_radar/disable_radar (GameLogic/src/player/economy.rs:353-373) and Common rts/player.rs:1882-1934 also never play the MiscAudio event. Player-visible: building/completing a Command Center (or Radar Van), power brownout, or EMP/sabotage never plays the radar-up/radar-down cue. Fix shape: read ini_misc_audio radar_online_sound/radar_offline_sound event names (fallback RadarOn/RadarOff), attach owning player index, honor okToPlayRadarEdgeSound gating.
close_reason: Radar edge audio now queues retail MiscAudio RadarOn/RadarOff instead of missing RadarOnline/RadarOffline.

title: EnableRepulsors never enabled on live host - civilian REPULSOR panic is dead code
description: C++ / leftover / live / player-visible. Retail AI.ini AiData sets EnableRepulsors = Yes (parsed at AI.cpp:141 into TAiData::m_enableRepulsors; ctor default false). With it on, ActiveBody::attemptDamage (ActiveBody.cpp:655-661) sets OBJECT_STATUS_REPULSOR on any damaged KINDOF_CAN_BE_REPULSED object, Object creates an ObjectRepulsorHelper (Object.cpp:337-344), and idle civilian AI flees nearby repulsors (AI.cpp:757) - the retail civilian-panic behavior. Live Main: GameLogic.enable_repulsors defaults false (game_logic/construct.rs:44) and world_tick/teams.rs set_enable_repulsors is only ever called from world_tests (crates_and_salvage.rs:39,120,131); no AI.ini/AiData load exists anywhere in Main, and host_repulsor_gate (used by object/damage.rs:457 repulsor stamping) mirrors the same false default. Player-visible: damaged civilians never become repulsors and other civilians never scatter/flee during firefights on the live host, while retail C++ civilians panic and run. Fix locus: default enable_repulsors to retail AI.ini value (or parse AiData) at game start so the existing gate, stamp, and find_closest_repulsor/try_idle_repulse paths go live.
close_reason: Live start_new_game applies retail AIData EnableRepulsors=Yes (ctor stays false). AIData.ini preload is disk-first, inits leftover THE_AI, and syncs host_repulsor_gate so civilian REPULSOR panic is live.

title: [Veterancy] SpawnBehavior master/spawn rank sync never runs
description:

SpawnBehavior::computeAggregateStates syncs master and spawn to the higher veterancy every update, re-running onVeterancyLevelChanged.

## Live
host_slave_drones.rs has no veterancy sync. Drone spawn/attach never reads master rank.

## Player-visible
Veteran/Elite tank or Humvee Scout/Battle/Hellfire drone stays Regular — no HP/armor/weaponset bonus.

title: [Veterancy] Promote FX/sound ignores stealth-hide and provideFeedback=FALSE
description:
## C++
Object::onVeterancyLevelChanged hides animation when !isLocallyControlled && STEALTHED && !DETECTED && !DISGUISED. Only plays LevelGain + UnitPromoted when doAnimation && getDrawIconUI && provideFeedback. RiderChangeContain and hijack pass FALSE.
